title: Senior Technical Analyst
description:
Job Purpose

Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE:ICE) is a Fortune 500 company that operates a leading network of global futures, equity and equity options exchanges, as well as global clearing and data services across financial and commodity markets.

By putting the needs of our customers and global participants first, we are a high-growth company that started by bringing transparency and risk management to the global derivatives markets. We're engineers, strategists and problem-solvers who continually create and improve technology that solves market structure challenges on behalf of the industry.

The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure ongoing compliance with ICE Clear Europe's (ICEU) constantly evolving regulatory reporting obligations, notably in respect to CFTC Part 39, SFTR and EMIR transaction reporting.

The candidate will be involved in the overall management of regulatory focused projects within the department, including the production of business requirements, reviewing & approving functional specifications and the user acceptance testing/validation of the final reporting deliveries. This will require comprehensive knowledge of ICEUs regulatory requirements, industry standards and company policies. As well as a good understanding of project delivery lifecycle process and ability to coordinate closely with ICE's technology development teams based in Atlanta.

The role will require an understanding of the legislation underpinning the regulatory reports and the ability to analyse the impact from changes to that legislation on those reports. The candidate will be expected to assist with questions and requests from, regulatory authorities, particularly the Bank of England, ESMA and the CFTC. Some of these requests may be complex and urgent in nature and ICEU senior management places a high priority on this work.

Experience with business automation tools such as Power Automate, N8N or AI-driven technologies is desirable. The firm is actively adopting such tooling across a range of use cases including operational workflow automation, testing assistance, automated email responses and chatbot development, and the successful candidate will have the opportunity to contribute to this agenda.

Responsibilities
  • Assist with Project Management of regulatory reporting initiatives: including planning process, business requirement definition, test design, planning and execution are key aspects of the role.
  • Perform daily operational tasks including diagnosing and resolving reporting exceptions, monitoring daily reconciliations, and incident management.
  • Provide functional guidance to development team(s) on new reporting activities or modifications of existing activities, specification changes and issue resolution
  • Monitor Regulatory Activities: Ability to analyse changes to legislation and rules and the impact on regulatory reporting, and respond to those that may impact ICEU.
  • Maintain Records and Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of compliance activities, including documentation of regulatory interactions.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders: Collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as risk business units, operations, and other departments, to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Support automation of day-to-day operational processes, including development of automated workflows using RPA tools such as Power Automate, to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention


Knowledge and Experience

The areas involved are numerous and complex. Regulatory reporting requires an understanding of transaction flow through various clearing states such as risk management, operational processes and treasury management. Regulatory reporting experience is desired, preferably knowledge of EMIR, SFTR, CFTC 39.19 and ISO20022 CCP Supervisory Reporting. However, other regulatory reporting experience, such as understanding of MIFID II, MIFIR or Fundamental Review of Trading Book (FRTB) will be considered if it demonstrates the skills required to interpret regulation and how to apply it to business processes.

Ideally the candidate would come from a clearing background, with good knowledge of the overall regulatory landscape. However, experience of working in the Finance sector for a number of years and the capacity to quickly understand the sometimes complex and extensive business processes and data is key.

Futures and Options knowledge is preferred, ideally including an understanding of the concepts, terminology and lifecycle of the contracts. Knowledge of post trade / clearing applications and functions therein is desirable as is any specific experience of energy and/or commodities markets.

IT skill set - experience with SQL or other data analysis tools across big datasets, demonstrating analytical and data skills across business data. Experience with AI technologies is increasingly desirable. This may include practical experience of AI-assisted analysis tools, prompt engineering or the application of AI within operational or reporting workflows.

Education
  • Higher level education


Desirable
  • Training in IT development methodologies, such as Agile, Waterfall

title: Director, Product Quality
description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Director of Product Quality to lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of Product Quality across WHOOP's Hardware and Accessories & Apparel (A&A) portfolio. This leader will be responsible for ensuring every product launches with exceptional quality through disciplined risk management, robust validation, and scalable quality systems while building the operating mechanisms that govern product quality throughout the product lifecycle: including new product introduction, launch readiness, and post-launch product changes. Working closely with Hardware Engineering, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, Reliability, and Field Quality, you will build and lead a world-class Product Quality organization that enables exceptional member experiences from concept through product lifecycle management.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define and execute the Product Quality strategy across Hardware and Accessories & Apparel (A&A), spanning New Product Introduction (NPI), launch readiness, product change management, and product lifecycle quality.

  • Lead Product Quality across the development lifecycle by driving quality planning, risk management, validation & verification, and manufacturing readiness in partnership with Engineering, Supplier Quality, Reliability, Operations, and Manufacturing Engineering.

  • Own Product Change Management by establishing the operating model, governance, and quality decision gates (e.g., OK2PVT, OK2Ship) that ensure engineering changes are appropriately assessed, validated, approved, and deployed throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Establish Product Quality operating mechanisms, quality metrics, and executive reporting that provide visibility into launch readiness, product quality, organizational performance, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Build and develop a high-performing Product Quality organization across Hardware and A&A, coaching managers and engineers while fostering a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Partner with Quality leadership peers to build and own a world class closed loop QMS to effectively collect field performance data and feed it into the product development process.

  • Serve as the Product Quality leader across the organization, influencing product strategy and driving alignment across Engineering, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, and Field Quality to deliver exceptional member experiences.

  • Willingness and able to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally to partners, suppliers, and contract manufacturers

    QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline; Master's degree preferred.

  • 15+ years of experience leading Product Quality, NPI Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Product Engineering organizations supporting high-volume consumer electronics, wearables, consumer products, or similarly complex hardware, including significant people leadership experience.

  • Demonstrated success defining quality strategy and building scalable operating mechanisms that improve product readiness, launch quality, and organizational performance.

  • Deep expertise in quality systems and methodologies including DFMEA, PFMEA, CTQ, SPC, MSA, DOE, root cause analysis, CAPA/8D, Design for Manufacturability, and statistical quality methods.

  • Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, and external partners in fast-paced environments.

  • Experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturing partners throughout product development and product launch.

  • Excellent communication, analytical, and systems-thinking skills with the ability to translate complex technical and operational data into clear priorities and business decisions.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

    This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

    Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

    WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

    The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

    At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

    The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $200,000-$245,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

    In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

    These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

title: Balance Sheet Specialist
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Balance Sheet Specialist within PNC's Finance organization, you will be based in either Pittsburgh, PA or Delaware, supporting key balance sheet management and financial operations activities.

PNC is seeking a detail-oriented and analytically driven Balance Sheet Specialist to join the ALM Valuations team. This role plays a critical part in supporting the valuation, financial reporting, risk analysis, and governance of Commercial Mortgage Servicing Rights (CMSR), a significant balance sheet asset tied to the servicing of commercial real estate loans.

The successful candidate will leverage strong financial modeling, accounting, and data analytics skills to evaluate the performance and fair value of CMSR assets, support regulatory and management reporting, and identify emerging trends and risks within the commercial real estate portfolio. Responsibilities include performing valuation analyses, preparing journal entries and balance sheet reporting, monitoring portfolio performance, conducting P&L attribution analysis, and supporting key business decisions related to servicing rights acquisitions and bidding activities.

This position offers the opportunity to work closely with business partners, valuation experts, technology teams, external vendors, and senior stakeholders to enhance valuation methodologies, automate reporting processes, and strengthen model governance practices. The role also contributes to model monitoring, back-testing, documentation, and interactions with risk management, audit, and regulatory partners. Candidates will have the opportunity to expand their expertise across additional ALM Valuations functions, including Residential Mortgage Servicing Rights (RMSR) Valuations and Price Testing.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in finance, accounting, valuation, and financial reporting, with experience in financial modeling and data analysis. Familiarity with tools such as Hyperion, Essbase, Oracle, Python, or VBA is a plus. This role is well-suited for professionals seeking exposure to complex balance sheet management, valuation analytics, and strategic decision-making within a large financial institution.

Successful candidates will have a bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, along with experience in financial reporting, financial modeling, and data analysis. Familiarity with Hyperion, Essbase, Oracle, Python, or VBA is beneficial but not required.

title: Content Specialist, Enterprise
description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We're hiring a Content Specialist to join our Enterprise Content Team in Toronto and Vancouver.

Along with your resume, please share a portfolio or examples of content you’ve produced, ideally across different formats. They don’t need to be polished portfolio pieces; we just want to see how you write and how you think about the audience and channel.

Who you are:

This role is the engine of Clio’s Enterprise content team. You keep work moving, drafts sharp, and projects on track. You will produce first drafts across a range of formats, manage the content calendar in Sprout and Asana, and coordinate the logistics that turn a content plan into published work.

You work under the direction of the Senior Manager, Content Strategy, and in close partnership with the Content Strategist, Enterprise. This is not a passive executor role. We want someone who notices things like a signal from a Sales call, a content gap, a format that isn’t landing and brings it to the table. You don’t need to have the answer. You just need to surface it fast so we can figure it out together. The Enterprise team moves quickly and expects the same from you.

What you’ll work on:

Content production and first drafts

  • Produce first drafts across content formats including blog posts, social content, email copy, one-pagers, landing pages, webinar abstracts, and campaign assets.

  • Write video scripts for shorter-form content including social videos, product explainers, and supporting thought leadership formats by capturing the speaker’s voice and making complex ideas land quickly on screen.

  • Write clearly and on-brand for enterprise audiences, with an understanding of how tone and format should shift across channels and buyer stages.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate drafts, while recognizing when output needs significant reworking to reflect Clio’s voice and the ability to close that gap quickly is as important as the ability to prompt well.

  • Iterate quickly based on feedback: get to a strong draft fast, don’t wait for perfect conditions to start.

  • Support the Content Strategist in developing assets by producing research, outlines, and supporting content.

Content calendar and project management

  • Own the day-to-day management of the Enterprise content calendar in Asana and Sprout Social by keeping projects on track, deadlines visible, and nothing falling through the cracks.

  • Set up and maintain content workflows in Asana, flagging bottlenecks or capacity issues before they become problems.

  • Schedule and publish social content through Sprout Social, ensuring content is formatted, tagged, and timed correctly for each channel.

  • Coordinate with freelancers and external contributors when applicable, including briefing, tracking deliverables, and managing timelines.

Campaign and distribution support

  • Support integrated campaign execution by preparing and distributing content assets across web, email, social, and paid channels.

  • Assist with ABM programs by adapting and personalizing content for priority accounts and key enterprise segments.

  • Ensure published content is accurate, on-brand, and consistent across channels.

Insight gathering and stakeholder awareness

  • Stay alert to signals from across the business such as conversations with Sales and Legal Architects, observations from Customer Success, trends in the market and proactively share anything that could inform our content approach.

  • Participate in cross-functional meetings and surface relevant insights to the Senior Manager and Content Strategist without waiting to be asked.

  • Support performance reporting by pulling data, tracking KPIs, and flagging anything that looks interesting or worth investigating.

Editorial and brand quality

  • Edit and proofread your own work and supporting materials to a high standard before they reach the Content Strategist or Senior Manager for review.

  • Apply SEO, conversion, and buyer journey best practices to content where relevant.

  • Ensure all content adheres to brand guidelines and maintains consistency in voice, tone, and messaging across channels.

What you may have:

  • 3-5 years of experience in content marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS, legal technology, or a legal environment (Big Law or in-house legal).

  • Strong writing and editing skills with the ability to produce clean, on-brand first drafts quickly and across multiple formats.

  • Hands-on experience managing a content calendar and coordinating content workflows.

  • Proficiency with Sprout Social and Asana, or equivalent tools; comfortable owning the operational side of a content program.

  • Curious and proactive: you notice things, connect dots, and bring observations forward without being asked.

  • Comfortable working with limited information and iterating fast; you don’t wait for a perfect amount of data to get started.

  • Willing to get hands-on with Clio’s product to understand what it does and how enterprise customers use it. You don’t need to arrive with product knowledge, but you need to be the kind of person who goes and figures it out.

  • Strong brand instincts: you can tell when an AI draft sounds like AI, and you know how to fix it.

  • Proficiency with AI writing and research tools is required, including Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT. Candidates must be able to speak to live, practical examples of how they use these tools in their day-to-day work.

This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

  • Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance

  • Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.

  • Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.

  • $2000 annual counseling benefit

  • RRSP matching and RESP contribution

  • Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The expected salary range for this role is $77,300 to $104,500 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Elevated Shopping
description:

Amazon is building the next generation shopping experience, with a massive collection of inventory from various brands, so customers have a seamless shopping experience. Today the online clothing shopper faces challenges on multiple fronts: discovering interesting items in a sea of products, evaluating fit, assessing cut and other style details.

In this role you will design and build the user experiences on the surfaces our customers interact with (i.e. mobile web, mobile app, desktop). You will work with Product and UX design to understand and create solutions for diverse user requirements (e.g., accessibility, internationalization), user hardware constraints, and security risks. You instrument software with real user metrics (e.g., taps/clicks, feature interaction, performance, fatals) to provide data and protect the customer experience. You will find bold and innovative ways to drive down latency. You will build, create, and deliver the right experience for customers, and make Amazon Fashion the daily destination for inspirational fashion worldwide.

As a member of the team, you can have a huge impact on everything from the functionality we deliver for our customers, to the architecture and operational excellence of our systems, to the algorithms we employ, to the culture we build. Engineers on the team enjoy a low operations load, focus on delivery, and are highly encouraged to explore personal ideas that will deliver significant customer impact or technical benefits to the team or more.

title: RN ICU
description:

This role is responsible for coordinating and delivering high-quality care based on established clinical protocols and physician/provider orders. The RN collaborates with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure effective patient care and desired outcomes, while maintaining a supportive and compassionate environment for patients and their families.

Essential Functions

  • Coordinates and delivers high-quality, patient-centered care in accordance with organizational policies, protocols, and the nursing process.
  • Conducts thorough patient assessments and documents findings accurately, reporting changes in condition to the appropriate care team members.
  • Utilizes knowledge of human growth and development to provide age-appropriate care and education.
  • Administers prescribed medications, monitors for side effects, and documents administration in accordance with standards of practice.
  • Assists physicians during procedures within the scope of documented competency and skill level.
  • Collaborates with the healthcare team to develop, implement, and evaluate individualized care plans based on patient assessments and needs.
  • Responds to medical emergencies and participates in life-saving interventions, such as CPR and code team activities, as appropriate.

  • Provides patient and family education on medical conditions, treatment plans, and post-discharge care, ensuring understanding and adherence to instructions.
  • Implements and adheres to infection control protocols to prevent the spread of healthcare-associated infections.
  • Monitors and operates medical equipment (e.g., IV pumps, monitors, ventilators) as needed for patient care and safety.
  • Promotes patient safety by adhering to National Patient Safety Goals and maintaining a clean, safe environment for patients and staff.
  • Participates in audits, chart reviews, and compliance checks to ensure adherence to standards of practice and regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrates responsible decision-making in planning, delegating, and providing care based on patient needs and organizational policies.
  • Documents patient care and education thoroughly and promptly in the medical record.
  • Engages in professional development to maintain clinical competency and understanding of current nursing standards and regulations.
  • Participates in performance improvement initiatives, including data collection and process development, to enhance patient outcomes and care delivery.
  • Critical Care RN:
    • Administers medications and other treatments as prescribed, including intravenous medications and therapies.
    • Manages complex medical equipment, including ventilators, monitoring devices, and other life-support systems.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 0-2 years of experience in a clinical nursing role or student clinical rotations in an acute care setting required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of the nursing process and clinical nursing practices.
  • Ability to perform thorough patient assessments and communicate findings effectively.
  • Proficient in administering medications and monitoring for side effects.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with interdisciplinary teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting patient care.
  • Knowledge of safety standards, infection control, and quality improvement initiatives.

Licenses and Certifications

  • RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure and/or Compact State Licensure required
  • BCLS - Basic Life Support required
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiac Life Support preferred
  • PALS - Pediatric Advanced Life Support preferred
  • NRP - Neonatal Resuscitation preferred
  • Refer to facility or unit-specific guidelines for additional requirements.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S for any employer.

Longview Regional Medical Center is your community healthcare provider, a 224-bed facility. We believe in the power of people to create great care. And we work hard every day to be a place of healing, caring and connection for patients and families in the community we call home. We pride ourselves in going above and beyond for our patients, and for our community.

Founded in 1871, the seat of Gregg County and said to be named for the view from Mr. Methvin’s front porch. (The owner of the land at the time it was purchased by the railroad.) Welcome to a community where you can experience big city living, with a small town community. Being close to Interstate 20 gives you access to all the big cities of the state. With Dallas being less than 2 hours away, you’re a hop jump and a skip to the city. The community of Longview is warm and welcoming. We have everything you could ever want in a community, the only thing we are missing is you!

title: Senior Business Analyst, GOEST (Global Operations Enterprise Services - Tech)
description:
Do you get restless when you see a manual, repetitive process that could be done smarter? We are looking for a senior Business Analyst to help run the strategic planning engine behind a large technology organization, and to reinvent how that engine works using data and automation.

This is a build-and-own role, not a support seat. You will take ambiguous problems, decide what matters, design the solution, and drive it independently. Day to day, you will:

- Run our planning cycles end to end, coordinating inputs across many teams, surfacing the tradeoffs and risks leaders need to decide on, and making the process cleaner every time

- Set the standards for how teams work together, then automate them so things run consistently with less manual effort

- Build our tracking and analytics from the ground up, so leaders can see how goals are progressing and catch problems before they become misses

- Find the repetitive, administrative work in how we operate and replace it with AI-powered tools and workflows that save time for everyone

If you would rather be handed a hard question than a checklist, and you love turning messy, manual work into something that just runs, this role is built for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the planning cycle mechanism itself: the workback schedule, the input templates, the points of contact, and the consolidation into a single leadership-ready view of priorities, dependencies, and risks. You keep the trains running and redesign the tracks.

- Author the standards that other teams operate by (intake routes, folder structures, handoffs, triage criteria) and codify them into automated, self-serve mechanisms so the process no longer depends on someone remembering the steps.

- Define the metrics and data model behind goal tracking, partner with data owners to guarantee fidelity, and stand up the reporting that shows progress against plan and where valuation or validation gaps exist.

- Scope, prototype, and ship automation and AI-assisted tooling against the highest-friction recurring work, then measure the time it gives back to the team and our partners.

- Judge which decisions are reversible versus not, make the reversible ones yourself, and bring the rest forward with a clear recommendation and the tradeoffs laid out.

- Influence teams you do not manage to adopt shared standards and cadences, resolving competing priorities before they become blockers.

- Mentor others on analytical rigor and raise the quality bar for how the team turns data into decisions.

A day in the life
Your focus is understanding how all the pieces of a large organization fit together, and drawing the insights everyone else misses because they are heads-down on their own worlds.

The planning and coordination work puts a stream of inputs in front of you from teams across the org. The real value is what you do with it: connecting the dots between them, spotting the pattern or the risk no single team can see, and telling that story clearly enough to change what leaders decide. Along the way you make the process itself faster and cleaner so the picture keeps getting sharper.

You will spend real time influencing people who do not report to you, and you will have room to chase the insights that move the whole organization further than it would have gotten otherwise.

About the team
The "Strategic Planning & Initiatives" team is the connective tissue of a large technology organization. When other teams are heads-down on their own piece, we make sure the pieces add up: that plans line up, dependencies do not collide, and leaders get one clear read on where things stand.

Our mission is to free the delivery teams to focus on their customers by taking the coordination, planning, and reporting complexity off their plates. We care about substance over busywork, look for smarter ways to work (including AI), and value people who think independently and make everyone around them sharper.

title: Injury Prevention Specialist
description:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. Wellness Education - Champion a culture of proactive health and injury prevention through innovative training programs and hands-on coaching. Develop and deliver engaging ergonomic education that empowers associates to make informed decisions about their wellbeing. Build trusted partnerships with operations teams to integrate prevention strategies into daily workflows. Create sustainable behavior change through personalized coaching and positive reinforcement techniques.

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, AWS Marketplace Buyer Fulfillment

title: Senior UX Designer, Amazon Delivery Customer Experiences
description:
Have you ever realized you forgot to add something to an order that's already on its way — wishing you could simply toss it in before the truck leaves? Amazon Delivery's Customer Experiences team (ADX CX) is seeking our next Senior UX Designer to keep evolving our experience of adding items to deliveries already in motion, turning a moment of missed opportunity into one of effortless convenience. In this role, you'll navigate the intersection of real-time logistics constraints and customer intent, designing experiences that make a complex behind-the-scenes orchestration feel simple and intuitive to millions of shoppers. Working directly with senior leaders and multi-disciplinary teams across partner organizations, you'll uncover when and how customers want to consolidate purchases, and translate those insights into novel interactions that challenge traditional assumptions about the finality of a placed order. Your work will define a new category of delivery experience — one where flexibility feels natural and every package is an open invitation rather than a closed transaction. As a part of our team, you'll also be connected with a broader group of designers and researchers in a design organization working through different lenses to elevate our delivery customer experience overall.

Qualities that will help you succeed:
• You are creative, curious, comfortable working in cross-functional environments and show a strong bias for action to deliver results.
• You will have a consistent track record of developing and launching new ideas and step-change improvements.
• You balance time and business constraints when improving experiences for the customer while pushing toward the vision of the ideal experience for the customer
• You are proactive in driving alignment and navigating debates through effective communication and relationship-building.



Key job responsibilities
As a key driver in designing solutions and up-leveling the quality of our customer experiences, you will:
• Bring forward innovative ideas and solutions and raise the bar on customer's experience with delivery.
• Effectively advocate and design for the customer through objective data such as market analysis, customer insights, technical constraints/opportunities, and business insights.
• Partner closely with business and development teams to plan and balance immediate changes with long-term, scalable solutions.
• Quickly and thoroughly creating user flows, wire frames, visual designs, and prototypes to effectively concept and communicate detailed interaction behaviors that support decision making and development.
• Assess and optimize the effectiveness of new and existing features by proactively planning, performing, and advocating validation techniques like usability testing, user research, and interpreting analytic data.
• Present design work to UX partners, cross-disciplinary teams, and executive leaders.

About the team

Amazon Delivery’s Customer Experiences team (ADX CX) is a diverse group of designers and researchers that share our experiences and help each other succeed. We operate within the broader Amazon Delivery Experience design organization that includes teams focused on operational and transportation experiences critical to the success of the holistic delivery journey. We value individuals who drive inspiration, collaboration, and connection by bringing their authentic selves to work and respecting everyone’s unique voices. We love complex problems, growing in fast-evolving environments, taking action, and learning from mistakes. We champion the customer voice (spoken and unspoken) through objective insights that inform the collective design and increase customer empathy across Amazon. Our creative work impacts millions of customers worldwide and we are proud to be a part of it.

description:
Amazon's Middle Mile Surface Research Science seeks an Applied Scientist to invent and build machine learning models that improve how Amazon plans and operates its transportation network.

Amazon's transportation network moves millions of truckloads of freight between vendors, warehouses, and customers using a fleet of trucks, trains, and airplanes, on time and at low cost. Operating it requires constant decisions about how to route, schedule, and balance capacity across the network, and our strategy is to make those decisions with science-driven technology. Because existing techniques rarely fit Amazon's scale and unique business needs, this role centers on inventing new approaches and algorithms.

As an Applied Scientist, you'll develop machine learning, forecasting, and prediction models and algorithms. Your first project will focus on trailer imbalance forecasting and safety stock optimization to improve our equipment re-balancing strategy, where you'll own the prediction models and grow your scope over time. Your models will impact business decisions worth billions of dollars and improve the delivery experience for millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop machine learning, forecasting, and other prediction models that enhance our optimization and planning systems.
- Build models and algorithms from prototype to production-level systems.
- Translate ambiguous business problems into modeling approaches, and drive the technical design with product, engineering, and operations partners.
- Influence key business decisions through rigorous modeling and analysis.
- Communicate results and recommendations to scientific and business audiences.

A day in the life
- Analyze data to investigate a business problem or model performance and identify improvements
- Brainstorm new algorithmic strategies or business opportunities with fellow scientists
- Leverage GenAI to build and test your new model features
- Run a simulation or experiment to evaluate your model’s performance
- Meet with product and tech partners to review project requirements, data, design, or other project decisions
- Review code changes or a design document from a fellow scientist or engineers
- Write and present a paper documenting algorithm features, results, and recommendations

About the team
Middle Mile Surface Research Science builds the models and algorithms that plan and operate Amazon's middle mile network. Our work spans operations research, optimization, and machine learning. We work on vehicle route planning, capacity planning, scheduling, network design, transit-time prediction, demand forecasting, and equipment re-balancing. Our team of about ten scientists is part of a broader science organization whose scientists bring deep expertise in machine learning and optimization. We optimize decisions worth billions of dollars and reach millions of customers.

The Cherokee Strip Regional Heritage Center in Enid, Oklahoma is seeking a historical interpreter to help share the history and culture of northwestern Oklahoma to the public. Whether the audience is an elementary field trip or the general public, a successful candidate will be an effective communicator and storyteller in a variety of settings. This position assists the director of education in the development of educational programs on northwest Oklahoma history and the presentation of these programs to the public. This includes conducting tours at the Cherokee Strip Regional Heritage Center, providing information about the history of northwestern Oklahoma, and performing other related tasks such as recruiting and supervising volunteers and staff, greeting visitors, and assisting in operating the visitor services desk when needed. Other duties include assisting with social media management, outreach programming, and collaborating with community businesses and other regional museums.

Some training is available.


Education:

Minimum education and experience requirements for this position consist of a bachelor’s degree in history, museum studies, anthropology, archaeology, elementary education or a closely related field and one year of experience as an interpreter/educator or curator in a museum or historic site or teaching in the fields of history, anthropology, archaeology or elementary education; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

The ideal candidate brings a minimum of 15 years of progressively increasing geoscience experience, including unconventional development, operations support, development planning, well planning, subsurface characterization, and integrated reservoir understanding. This role is expected to operate with significant independence, provide technical advice and guidance within the agreed asset strategy, build effective networks across disciplines, mentor and develop others, and contribute to annual plans, priorities, and budget decisions for a small operational area or major development program.

  • Develop and influence surveillance and data acquisition plans, including fit-for-purpose technology assessment, cost-efficient acquisition strategies, and interpretation workflows that de-risk appraisal and development plans while maximizing return on investment.

  • Experience contributing to or leading substantial aspects of major projects, programs, or processes, including resource coordination, progress tracking, goal attainment, and alignment with business priorities.

title: Senior Software Engineer (SDK)
description:
About the Role

This is a high-ownership engineering role at a fast-growing, open-source AI engineering platform — think of it as the Datadog for LLM observability. The platform is trusted by thousands of development teams worldwide, and the SDKs you'll own are downloaded millions of times each month, often serving as the very first touchpoint a developer has with the product.

The SDKs run in production environments ranging from serverless functions to long-running agent loops. They must be rock-solid: minimal CPU and memory overhead, zero tolerance for failure, and a developer experience that feels effortless. When you ship, thousands of developers benefit the same day.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Python and TypeScript SDKs end-to-end — reliability, performance, and developer experience. Set the bar for SDK quality across the organization.

  • Design APIs developers love — naming conventions, parameter structure, breaking-change communication, and documentation. Every detail of the DX is yours to shape.

  • Drive OpenTelemetry-based integrations — architect and implement framework integrations across the AI/LLM ecosystem (e.g. major LLM providers, orchestration frameworks, agent runtimes).

  • Maintain and evolve the SDK release lifecycle — versioning strategy, packaging, CI/CD pipelines, compatibility testing, and automated release management.

  • Performance engineer the SDK — profile, identify bottlenecks, and reduce latency and memory footprint so the SDK is never the limiting factor in production.

  • Engage the open-source community — triage GitHub issues, review external PRs, write developer-facing docs, and represent the project on public channels.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally — work closely with product and data teams to translate platform capabilities into clean SDK abstractions.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building or maintaining SDKs or client libraries

  • Proven track record designing, implementing, and shipping production-grade SDKs — API design, versioning, packaging, and release management

  • Experience optimizing library performance: profiling, reducing latency and memory usage, improving throughput

  • Hands-on experience with observability, tracing, metrics, or monitoring systems (OpenTelemetry experience is a strong plus)

  • Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript and the ability to write idiomatic, language-specific library code

  • Active experience contributing to and maintaining open-source projects (GitHub issues, PR reviews, community interactions)

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable writing docs, engaging with developers on GitHub, and participating in public technical discourse

  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines for libraries (unit/integration tests, release automation, compatibility testing)

  • Ability to work effectively in a small, distributed team across EU timezones

  • Legal authorization to work in the EU is required — visa sponsorship is not available

  • Ability to be onsite in Berlin approximately one week per month

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with analytics or large-scale telemetry systems (e.g. OLAP/columnar databases such as ClickHouse)

  • Background from companies in the developer tooling, AI/ML infrastructure, or observability space

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: €90,000 – €160,000 per year, depending on experience and location

  • Equity participation in a well-funded, high-growth startup (Seed/Series A stage)

  • Flexible, remote-first work environment across Europe

Location

This role is remote-friendly across Europe (team members are based in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, France, Sweden, the UK, Spain, and Poland). You'll be expected to travel to Berlin, Germany for onsite collaboration approximately once per month. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the EU — no visa sponsorship is available.

title: Summer 2027 Data Science Intern
description:
The Nuclear Company is the fastest growing AI tech-startup in the nuclear and energy space, pioneering a fleet-scale approach to building the next generation of nuclear reactors. Through our design-once, build-many model, we're accelerating the deployment of safe, reliable, and affordable nuclear energy.

We operate with an AI-first mindset. Every employee is expected to leverage AI, technology, and the Nuclear Operating System (NOS) as integral components of their role to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. We expect every team member to continuously identify opportunities to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of NOS as a strategic operating capability that enables The Nuclear Company to scale with excellence.

We hire people who are driven by purpose, thrive in ambiguity, and are energized by building what has never been built before. Our team combines intellectual curiosity with high agency, embraces candid feedback and continuous learning, and holds themselves and others to exceptional standards. Our values—Trust, Responsibility, Unity, Scrappiness, and Tenacity—guide how we hire, collaborate, and make decisions every day. They are not words on a wall; they are the standard by which we operate. Trust is the foundation of our safety culture, fostering intellectual honesty, accountability, and open communication, while our values challenge every team member to execute with urgency, humility, resilience, and an unwavering commitment to our mission.

About the role

The United States is building nuclear power again, and The Nuclear Company is writing the software that makes it possible. NOS, the Nuclear Operating System, runs the regulatory, supply chain, cost, schedule, and field work behind real reactor construction. The work matters for national security, energy independence, and the climate.

You will turn data into decisions that move a nuclear build forward. As a Data Science Intern, you do the full applied data science job on NOS: frame the question, wrangle the data, build and validate models, and put the answer in front of the people who act on it. You will work on forecasting and decision analysis for megaproject cost and schedule, extend the NOS ontology and data model, and build the analyses and dashboards leaders use to make real calls. You work next to full-time data scientists and ship work that reaches production.

This is a 12-week Summer 2027 internship (May to August), aligned to the academic calendar. Base location is Washington DC, on-site five days a week, with full housing and relocation for interns outside the DC metro area.

Responsibilities

  • Frame business and engineering questions with stakeholders, then source, clean, and explore the data needed to answer them.
  • Build and validate models (forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, decision analysis) for megaproject cost, schedule, and risk.
  • Engineer features and extend the NOS ontology and data model across regulatory, supply chain, cost, and schedule domains.
  • Build data pipelines across Palantir Foundry, AWS GovCloud, and more.
  • Design metrics, dashboards, and analyses that operators, engineers, and executives use to make decisions, and communicate findings clearly.

Required Experience

  • Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Math, or a related quantitative field. Expected graduation between December 2027 and June 2028, and returning to school after the internship.
  • Strong Python and the data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), with working knowledge of SQL.
  • Foundation in statistics and probability, and a track record of completed data analysis (course, personal, research, or prior internships).
  • This position requires access to information and technology subject to U.S. export controls (including DOE 10 CFR Part 810 and NRC requirements). U.S. Person status (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident) is required, and TNC does not provide visa sponsorship for these roles.
  • Willing and able to work on-site in Washington DC, five days a week, for the full 12-week program.

Preferred Experience

  • Data visualization and dashboarding; exposure to cloud data warehouses.
  • Forecasting, time-series, or experimental design.
  • Coursework or project experience with Palantir Foundry or AWS.
  • Interest in energy, national security, industrial software, or regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with nuclear engineering concepts (not required, we teach the domain)

Benefits

  • 401k with company match
  • Medical, dental, vision plans

title: Full Stack Software Dev Engineer
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.


Ford’s Electric Vehicles, Digital and Design (EVDD) team is charged with delivering the company’s vision of a fully electric transportation future. EVDD is customer-obsessed, entrepreneurial, and data-driven and is dedicated to delivering industry-leading customer experience for electric vehicle buyers and owners. You’ll join an agile team of doers pioneering our EV future by working collaboratively, staying focused on only what matters, and delivering excellence day in and day out. Join us to make positive change by helping build a better world where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams.

In this position...

Vehicle Cloud & Mobile is seeking a Full Stack Engineer with 2–3 years of experience to join our organization. In this role, you will design, build, and scale the cloud platforms and APIs that power connected experiences for our mobile, retail, and fleet customers.

You will work across the software development lifecycle—collaborating with mobile and vehicle hardware teams to ensure seamless end-to-end integration, writing clean and secure backend services, and leveraging modern DevOps pipelines to deploy your code to the cloud.

What you'll do:

  • Build & Scale: Design, develop, and support robust APIs, microservices, and cloud-native platforms using Spring Boot (Java) and Ktor (Kotlin) frameworks.

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Deploy and manage services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) leveraging modern containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless technologies like Cloud Run and Cloud Pub/Sub.

  • End-to-End Integration: Collaborate cross-functionally with mobile app and vehicle/device teams to integrate, test, and triage end-to-end connected features.

  • DevOps & Automation: Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Cloud Build to ensure fast and reliable deployments.

  • Code Quality & Security: Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD) to ensure high code coverage. Leverage tools like SonarQube, Cycode, 42Crunch, and FOSSA to deliver secure, compliant, and high-quality software.

  • Observability & Support: Implement log management and system monitoring using Splunk or GCP Cloud Logging to proactively identify issues. Participate in on-call rotations to support critical outages.

  • Agile Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering Managers in an Agile/Scrum environment to break down complex requirements into incremental, production-ready user stories.

You’ll have...

Education: Bachelor’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field

Experience: 2–3 years of professional software engineering experience.

Technical Skills:

  • Hands-on experience developing microservices using Spring Boot (Java) or Ktor (Kotlin)

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

  • Experience leveraging containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes

  • Experience setting up or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, or Jenkins.

  • Commitment to code quality through Test-Driven Development (TDD).

  • Familiarity with static code analysis, licensing, and security tools (e.g., SonarQube, FOSSA, Cycode).

  • Experience with log management, monitoring, and alerting tools like Splunk or GCP Cloud Logging.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer , Tech Deployment
description:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org.

In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop. Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America.

You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits for you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets.

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

title: Principal Engineer, Private Markets Technology - Macquarie Group

As one of the world's largest and most experienced infrastructure and real assets investors, we play a significant role in financing, developing and managing the assets that underpin economies and communities globally.

Our Real Assets and Real Estate technology team operates at the intersection of investing, data and technology. Working directly with investment professionals, valuation and fund services teams, we solve complex challenges across the investment lifecycle and build the technology capabilities that support the future growth of our business.

The scale of our platform, combined with the increasing importance of data, automation and AI within private markets, creates a unique opportunity to influence how technology enables better decisions, drives operational excellence and delivers long-term value across a global investment business.

description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Capacity Planner Data Analyst

About your role:

You will develop and maintain forecasting and capacity planning models that support print production readiness, staffing, equipment planning, and client commitments. You will work with partners across Operations to analyze volume trends, evaluate capacity impacts, and improve planning accuracy. Your work helps Output Services make informed operational decisions and meet service commitments.

What you'll do:

  • Develop rolling production forecasts using historical volume data, product mix trends, and business inputs from Finance, Customer Service, client forecasts, and Operations
  • Evaluate forecast accuracy, identify sources of variance, and refine forecasting methodologies to improve model performance over time
  • Design and maintain capacity planning models that support facility, equipment, staffing, schedule, business continuity planning, and materials planning decisions
  • Analyze operational data using SQL, Python, Snowflake, and Power BI to generate reporting, control charts, scenario models, and planning insights
  • Perform what-if analyses to assess the operational impact of changes in schedules, staffing levels, machine capacity, run rates, product mix, and client volumes
  • Advise business leaders on schedule adjustments, overtime needs, downtime planning, alternate production processes, and workload balancing across facilities
  • Support business case development for equipment investments and new client opportunities by translating volume forecasts and capacity needs into financial and operational inputs
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 4+ years of experience in data analysis, forecasting, capacity planning, production planning, or operations analytics
  • 4+ years of experience using SQL to query, validate, and analyze operational or production data
  • 4+ years of experience building analytical models, dashboards, or reports using Python, Snowflake, Power BI, or similar data and visualization tools
  • 4+ years of experience identifying trends, measuring variance, and translating data into operational recommendations for business partners or leadership
  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience supporting forecasting, scheduling, or capacity planning in a production, print, mail, or operations environment
  • Experience building scenario models or what-if analyses to support staffing, equipment, or facility decisions
  • Experience contributing to business cases for capital investments or operational changes
  • Experience presenting analytical findings to senior leaders

How you'll work:

title: Principal, Product Manager-Tech , eShop
description:
The Premium Shopping Experience team is on a mission to firmly establish Amazon as the premier destination for shopping high-quality premium products. Shopping for premium products is more than a transactional purchase — it's an emotional investment in a shopping journey where the customer is treated to a personalized, curated experience that is visually appealing and immersive.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager-Tech to own the Content Freshness workstream — responsible for ensuring premium product pages, brand stores, and customer experience surfaces are populated with high-quality, up-to-date, visually elevated content at scale. This role is critical to delivering content-dependent features across the premium brand portfolio and increasing coverage with generative AI-assisted content.

Own the content freshness strategy for premium products, ensuring the premium catalog maintains elevated, brand-quality content across product detail pages, brand stores, and customer experience surfaces.

Define and scale the generative AI content pipeline, working with content production teams to generate elevated media — including product imagery, multi-product lifestyle content, and short-form motion assets — across the premium catalog.

Measure and report on content health — define content freshness KPIs (coverage percentage, staleness rate, content quality scores), track progress, and identify gaps requiring intervention.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Compliance & Security Assurance, Denied Party Screening
description:
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our mission is to prevent "denied entities" from transacting with Amazon businesses. We build automatic mechanisms to detect and prevent prohibited transactions with the "denied entities" using a diverse set of algorithms and machine learning techniques. We screen over a billion events every day and deal with unique scaling and TPS challenges. We are still Day 1 and have an exciting road map to build detection and resolution systems to help scale Amazon for years to come.

We are looking for an outstanding software engineer who has the passion for working on challenging problems from the very early stages. Together with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, ML scientists, and subject domain experts, you will help define our customer experience and protect Amazon brand. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, know how to deliver, are technical and innovative, and looking for an opportunity to build systems and solutions optimized for relationships (or graph), we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE in this role, you are responsible for:

* Building large-scale, high-availability, low-latency distributed systems.
* You work with your team to design, implement, test, release and maintain high-complexity software.
* You propose new and innovative solutions that you then develop and refine for production.
* You are the end-to-end owner of critical components that keep Amazon and its businesses compliant.

A day in the life
You'll see hundreds of millions of transactions being screened on a daily basis.
You will hear about various critical Amazon Businesses (our clients) and about Amazon Legal, Compliance or Operations (our stakeholders).
You'll work with highly experienced and dedicated peers to deliver on critical tasks and then you'll see your work directly impact our customers and our stakeholders.

About the team

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Senior / Staff Product Designer
description:
About the Role

We're a well-funded, Series A AI-powered procurement intelligence platform serving the industrial sector — helping companies modernise how they manage spend, suppliers, and sourcing through a suite of AI agents. Our product is used daily by non-technical procurement professionals who need AI to feel natural, trustworthy, and genuinely useful — not like a black box bolted onto a legacy workflow.

We're hiring a Senior or Staff Product Designer to join a small, high-craft design team embedded closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts. This is a pivotal role: you'll define how agentic AI capabilities surface in the product — from the moment an agent starts working, through to how findings and recommendations are presented and acted upon. Great design here doesn't just improve usability; it directly determines whether powerful AI features get adopted and whether customers realise real cost savings.

What You'll Do

  • Define interaction patterns for agentic AI capabilities — covering status states ("the agent is working"), result surfaces ("here's what it found"), and human-in-the-loop collaboration moments.

  • Design workflows that position AI and human judgment as collaborators, not competitors, with a clear focus on trust and transparency.

  • Produce short-horizon vision work (3–6 month horizon) as runnable prototypes and tangible artefacts that align and guide the broader team.

  • Raise overall product craft and coherence as engineering velocity and feature output scale.

  • Work directly in code for last-mile polish — check out PRs and fine-tune interactions before features ship.

  • Partner with product managers, engineers, and procurement domain experts to translate complex, data-heavy workflows into clear, usable experiences.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Senior-level product design experience with a strong portfolio of shipped work — ideally in B2B SaaS, complex workflows, or data-heavy products.

  • A "block-shaped" designer: solid across visual design, interaction design, product thinking, and prototyping in code — not a single-specialty generalist.

  • Demonstrated ability to prototype beyond Figma — you build runnable prototypes that communicate intent, behaviour, and edge cases.

  • Comfortable checking out PRs and making direct code-level interaction tweaks before shipping (this is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have).

  • Thoughtful, well-formed opinions on how AI should appear in products — trust, transparency, appropriate automation, and avoiding over-automation.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and inventing new patterns for genuinely novel problems.

  • Active daily user of AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) as part of your research, ideation, and prototyping workflow.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience designing for non-technical users in complex B2B domains (e.g. procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, finance).

  • Prior work on agentic or autonomous AI features in a shipped product.

  • Familiarity with industrial or procurement software contexts.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is based on-site in Munich, Germany. Candidates must be able to work from the Munich office. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Why This Role

  • Work at the frontier of agentic AI product design — inventing patterns that don't yet exist.

  • Join a well-resourced, Series A company backed by top-tier European and global investors, with strong customer traction in the industrial sector.

  • Small design team = high ownership, high visibility, and direct impact on product direction.

  • Collaborate with a team that includes alumni from leading strategy, consulting, and enterprise software organisations.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Black Cape

Title: UI/UX Designer

Locations:

  • Bethesda, MD
  • Washington, DC

Onsite: Expected to go onsite (into a SCIF) 3 - 5 days per week

Clearance: TS/SCI - Must be willing to get a CI Poly

***MUST have an Active TS/SCI clearance and be willing to get a CI Poly***

***If you do NOT have a US Citizenship or a Security Clearance issued by a US Government Customer, we will likely not get back to you. It is a REQUIREMENT of the job.***

Black Cape has Won “Best Places to Work” every year in existence by either the Washington Business Journal & Virginia’s Best Places to Work!

Want to be a part of an intelligent, talented, dynamic, and FUN team and keep building something GREAT?? Then, you should consider Black Cape!

  • We work with Department of War (DoW) and Intelligence Community (IC) customers to accomplish their missions
  • Come join us to work on cloud-native full-stack web applications, advanced data analysis tools, and machine learning capabilities
  • Be a part of a team that is making an impact and HAVE FUN while doing so!

About the company

Black Cape is a unique technology company with a focus on full-stack web applications, advanced data analysis tools, and integrating AI/ML capabilities for federal government customers.

We are a COOL and FUN crew that works hard and plays maybe even a little harder. Our core team is an impressive group of engineers with exceptional leadership at the helm.

Black Cape is led by proven business and engineering leaders with a track record of building innovative technology companies focused on building mission applications. We support many programs and agencies as both a prime and a subcontractor and created a strong reputation working with top tier partners doing work for all major Intelligence Community agencies, DoW, and Special Operations customers.

Our engineer-led software teams develop technical solutions on an aggressive schedule across the DoW and IC to meet customer needs. Our engineers apply proven, repeatable software, technical, and analytical approaches to build solutions and have frequent interaction with end users to produce and deploy solutions.

We bring experience in building, integrating and deploying AI/ML solutions using Google TensorFlow, Python scikit-learn, and other tools. Black Cape’s approach to solution development combines lessons learned from developing and deploying applications to customer cloud environments with industry best practices in Agile development and DevOps.

What we are hiring:

We are seeking a talented and security-cleared UI/UX Designer to join our mission-focused team. The systems you build will directly support national security, tactical operations, and critical decision-making for our government customers.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex government data and intuitive, human-centered software. Working directly within secure government facilities, you will collaborate face-to-face with developers, product owners, and end-users to drive the visual direction of our applications.

As the core designer for these systems, your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborative Design: Transforming feedback from analysts and operators into elegant, secure, and highly functional interfaces.

Required Technical Skills (MUST HAVES):
