  • Experience working onsite with DoD and/or IC customers
  • Strong ability to design wireframes, mockups, and prototypes for web applications
  • Strong ability to drive overall visual design, layout, and composition of web applications
  • Experience working with end-users to identify their needs, articulate challenges, and propose user-centric solutions
  • Familiarity collaborating with full-stack development teams in agile workflows
  • A portfolio or experience of recent design projects that demonstrates your skills in wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity visual design (if you have been onsite working on proprietary cleared projects - we do understand that you may not have recent visibility into your projects)
  • Experience with at least one of the following Design Tools: Figma (most important for this program), Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools - and/or willingness to learn new tools

Preferred Technical Skills (NICE TO HAVES):

  • Experience meeting with application stakeholders directly
  • Experience developing User Personas, User Studies, and Information Architecture
  • Proficient with JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Familiarity with modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue - understand how they work but do not have to have extensive experience coding in them
  • Familiarity with accessibility requirements and best practices

description:

The Juvenile and Domestic Relations District Court Services Unit is seeking a part-time Bilingual Relief Worker (English/Spanish) to supplement case coverage of full-time counselors for the Detention Diversion Program (DDP). This employee closely monitors the youth's behavior at home and in the community, primarily on weekends, to ensure compliance with the Court's rules and regulations. Juvenile offenders are a diverse group who may have parents with limited English skills.

The Detention Diversion Program (DDP) serves as an alternative to secure detention for some juvenile offenders. Instead of being detained at the Northern Virginia Juvenile Detention Center while awaiting a detention hearing, youths may be allowed to return home with their parents/guardians under court order.

Specific duties include:

  • Maintaining daily contact with clients on DDP caseload by telephone, in person visits, at their home, office, school or employment, including weekends and holidays;
  • Providing face-to-face contact with the parent or guardian per week, exceptions are made based on the case and when clients have legitimate emergencies or permission to be out of the area;
  • Documenting time contacting DDP clients over the weekend (and on holidays when applicable) and submitting time in PRISM on Monday mornings;
  • Maintaining updated case notes, including weekend coverage and hand-written case notes must be entered into BADGE system, and submitted to the DDP Supervisor every Wednesday;
  • Collaborating with DDP relief unit and Supervisor when necessary to discuss issues concerning caseloads; and
  • Performing other job-related duties as assigned.

The successful candidate will have the following:

  • Ability to complete documentation accurately and promptly;
  • Capacity to work independently to communicate client compliance and coordinate services among the DDP team members. Proficient English grammar, writing and proofreading skills; and
  • Ability to work with information of a legal, sensitive and confidential nature.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma/GED or equivalent;
  • Some experience providing human services, counseling, and/or probation services in the criminal justice field;
  • Must possess a valid Driver License; and
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish).

Substitution: College coursework in a human service-related field may substitute for up to one year of experience on a year-for-year basis.

Desirable Qualifications: Preference may be given to candidates with a Bachelor’s Degree in a related Human Services field and experience in one or more of the following:

  • Working in a multilingual and multicultural environment;
  • Understanding the Court system; and/or
  • Working with various community resources.

Special Requirements

Driver’s License: Employee must operate a vehicle to perform assigned duties in other county locations. The employee must possess, or obtain by the time of appointment, a valid driver license. They must authorize Arlington County to obtain or provide a copy of their official driving record. Any offer of employment may be contingent upon a favorable review of driving record.

Background Check: A pre-employment criminal record check will be conducted to include: National Crime Information Center (NCIC) check, Virginia Criminal Information Network (VCIN) background check, FBI fingerprints, and a Virginia Department of Social Services Child Protective Services Central Registry Search.

Please complete each section of the application including the supplemental questions. Your responses to the supplemental questions are required because they provide us with specific information necessary to evaluate your qualifications for this position. These responses are considered part of the selection process. A resume may be attached; however, it will not substitute for a completed application. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Please do not write "see resume" as a response to the questions.

Additional Information

Work Hours: Weekend only (Saturday and Sunday), 9:00am – 5:00pm or 12:00pm–8:00pm. Must work Holidays and be available at short notice or on call when needed.

title: Plant Project Engineer/Engineering Analyst (Generation) – GPC Plant Yates/Wansley
description:
Georgia Power

Job Description

Plant Project Engineer/Engineering Analyst (Generation) – GPC Plant Yates/Wansley

This posting serves to fill two roles for plant engineer/engineering analyst positions at Georgia Power facilities, one at Plant Yates (Newnan, Ga.) and another at Plant Wansley (Franklin, Ga.). Each site is building new generation to meet the demand of Georgia Power’s Customer Load growth with advanced class generation technology.

JOB SUMMARY

This engineer/engineering analyst role will be responsible for engineering related activities at a power generating plant. This position is responsible for providing technical support and developing long-term plans and budgets to maintain and improve plant equipment performance. Power Generation Engineers/Engineering Analysts manage capital and O&M projects, follow prescribed procedures, provide input on procedure improvements, and conduct analyses to review design options or recommendations for structures, systems, and components. This position is accountable for providing technical direction and troubleshooting for plant electrical and mechanical systems. This position will be responsible for providing ongoing inspection and evaluation of equipment for determining the appropriate direction regarding design and performance improvements, upgrades, and other modifications. This individual will be a troubleshooting resource for operations and maintenance and will be assigned to system ownership.

JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide outage/project management, project budget management, long-term maintenance strategies and technical support to the plant
  • Develop 5- & 10-year capital budgets and justification for associated capital projects
  • Provide monthly accruals and budget variance explanations to the Financial Analyst
  • Monitor plant performance and make recommendations to improve heat rate and unit reliability.
  • Serve as a system owner of assigned systems
  • Serve as a coordinator of project work – requires contract administrator training
  • Utilize computer business tools to monitor equipment operating performance, develop and justify budgets, plan project scope, develop project schedules, effectively use Maximo work order management system, and prepare reporting on equipment and projects.
  • Initiate, troubleshoot, and review root cause analyses for system equipment failures
  • Work with Southern Company Services (Technical Shared Services), OEMs, and system owners at other plants to stay current of any upgrades or concerns that affect the plant and communicate these needs to plant management, corporate management, and peer groups.
  • This role may also be assigned Long-Term Service Agreement (LTSA) administration/engineer role that is responsible for engaging with Mitsubishi Power Americas/Mitsubishi Heavy Industries for performance of the service contract to include, but not limited to: tracking performance & reliability of the equipment, ensuring vendor is keeping current with technical bulletins & recommendations, ensuring appropriate coverage of parts and maintenance activities, outage/maintenance intervals, budget tracking, & reporting.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education

  • B.S. in Engineering or Engineering Technology from an ABET accredited program/institution is required

Experience

  • Experience in an industrial facility with mechanical/electrical project or design focus involving the maintenance of the following types of equipment: pumps/motors, air/motor operated valves, fans, condensers, boilers, turbines, PLC’s, distributed control systems, and industrial electrical switchgear, circuit breakers, and transformers.
  • Demonstrated project management experience required
  • Strong technical expertise and problem-solving abilities required

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong organizational, administrative, time management, project management, facilitation and analytical skills are required
  • Knowledge and experience utilizing computers applications and the ability to learn new systems and applications quickly.
  • Self-motivation and demonstrated initiative are required for this position
  • Ability to interface with vendors and contractors while representing the best interests of Southern Company
  • Ability to network and utilize subject matter experts at both the corporate level and regional level to support our plant systems
  • Display interpersonal skills that demonstrate the ability to handle conflict and work effectively within a diverse team
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and requirements
  • Flexible to work across primary position boundaries by willingly accepting multiple roles as required to support plant needs

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • Must be available to work nights, weekends and/or holidays as needed.
  • May require some extended work hours.
  • Must be able to be on call for the plant as needed
  • Minimal Travel required – up to 25%

BENEFITS

  • Competitive Pay
  • Excellent benefits packages which include:
    • Medical and dental coverage
    • Defined Benefit Cash Balance Pension plan
    • Performance-sharing plan
    • 401(k) plan with a generous company match
    • Bonus opportunities
    • Tuition Reimbursement
  • If this job is determined to be a critical job, limitations for transferring internally within the Company may apply for a set period of time. If applicable, details will be shared during the selection process.

title: Logistics Generalist - Senior
description:
Applicants must have an Active Top Secret/SCI US Government clearance with polygraph. Note: US Citizenship is required to maintain a Top Secret/SCI clearance with polygraph.

Logistics Generalist - Senior Duties include adhering to the regulations/guidelines/SOPs of the Office of Logistics and the Sponsor's logistics and supply chain regulations, close coordination with senior Logistics staff officer (or their designated representative) in the appropriate Directorate/Mission Center/Component/Office of assignment, assisting with the administration and control for the purchase of materials and services; directing the complete process for transporting people and goods; overseeing materials management within area of assignment; coordinating and planning facility services; tracking cost issues and personnel resources; and administering elements of multi-faceted programs. Logistics Generalists could potentially travel to CONUS or OCONUS locations in support of temporary logistics requirements of the Directorate/Mission Center/Component/Office of assignment.

Duties/Tasks and Responsibilities

The Senior Logistics Generalist contractor is required to possess a highly diverse and experienced skill set regarding logistics operations. The duties/tasks and responsibilities described below are dependent on the office of assignment and subject to the priorities set by the senior Logistics staff Officer with purview over logistics operations where the Logistics Support Generalist is assigned. Duties tasks and responsibilities described below are dependent on the office of assignment.

  • Assists with purchasing of materials and services within area of assignment to include:
    • Assisting with the ordering of materials through a variety of internal and external sources; validating customer requirements against regulations and estimates costs.
    • Reconciling routine to moderately complex financial statements to ensure expenses are properly recorded; reconciling accounts payable to ensure accuracy and funding availability; and reviewing bills/invoices for accuracy.
  • Assists in the coordination and transportation of material and people.
    • Coordinates transportation processing by completing proper transportation documentation; learns how to ship and receive material; and assists in arranging transportation of material.
    • Arranges for appropriate stock levels of packing material /boxes/tape material for shipment of equipment (sometimes fragile equipment) and other stocked items, as necessary.
    • Prepares material for shipment to include safe-handling and packaging for shipment in accordance with Sponsor standards.
    • Contractor may be required to transport cargo, personnel, time-sensitive items, and equipment as necessary to fulfill Sponsor's mission.
    • Arranges for courier and/or chauffeur services by coordinating with appropriate transportation office.
    • In coordination with the appropriate component/mission support staff/or senior Logistics staff Officer, the contractor will research best transportation options for customers and determine best shipping methods based on customer, cargo type, and/or consignee timeline requirements to meet mission requirements.
    • Obtain approval in advance from the appropriate Logistics Directorate/Mission Center/Component/Office staff officer (or their designated focal point) for any freight/aviation and aviation planning requirements (large or small) that require coordination with the Sponsor's Transportation Fusion Center or any other entity involved in arranging aircraft scheduling.
    • Responds to courier and chauffeur requests; resolves scheduling problems.
  • Maintain inventories of goods and materials in accordance with this organization's regulations.
    • Processes inventory requests and validates receipt of goods and materials against requirements; ensures inventory requests are fulfilled.
    • Coordinates the maintenance of a fleet of vehicles by maintaining table of vehicular allowances and tracking database;
    • Fulfills property accountability and auditability actions in accordance with this organization's regulations and SOPs; plans and conducts property inventories and reconciles property discrepancies, and ensures proper disposal according to Sponsor's regulations/guidelines/office SOPs and appropriate recording of the actions.
    • Distributes and tracks parking permits, WEX cards, license plates (and renewals), E-ZPass devices, and other items as necessary.
    • Where required, serves as the Responsible Officer of record.
  • Coordinate with Sponsor's Facilities Management in the implementation of office moves, renovations, and maintenance.
    • Implements office moves; establishes schedules and procedures; ensures proper number of staff are available.
    • Assists Facilities Management in office renovations by serving as a liaison to customers and construction workers.
    • Schedules routine office maintenance; works with Facilities Management to ensure offices are properly maintained.
    • At any location: Coordinates with Facilities Management and IT Support to facilitate any computer movement, connections, and phone service.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Must possess exceptional customer service skills, a willingness to help others, and be flexible throughout any given working day regarding tasks conducted.
  • Ability to obtain extensive knowledge and application of overall Agency and logistics processes, policies, regulations, and unique authorities.
  • Extensive knowledge of overall logistics processes, policies, and regulations.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience utilizing various databases and applications independently.
  • Critical thinking skills necessary to comprehend the implications of process, policies and regulations against requirements.
  • Experience managing the general services functional areas: transportation processing, inventory management, vehicle management, and accountable property.
  • Adaptability to work independently and responsibly.
  • Interpersonal skills to establish a new network of professional working relationships with customers, colleagues, and service providers, while further developing existing networks.
  • Critical thinking skills to make decisions and solve complex problems effectively and independently.
  • Critical thinking skills to anticipate customer needs and requirements and identify alternative solutions.
  • Experience assisting in the effective planning, organizing and management of resources
  • Leadership skills to develop self and mentor other contractors, and ability to effectively manage and lead other contractors.
  • Working knowledge of Contracting Officer's Technical Representative (COTR) concepts and principles.
  • Working knowledge of Project Management concepts and principles.
  • Working knowledge of Fleet Management.
  • Ability to maintain a valid driver's license.

Work Environment

Depending on assignment, work is primarily performed in an office environment and may including conditions vary from an office environment where work is primarily sedentary to environments where extensive standing and/or walking; bending; lifting light to heavy objects or being exposed to noise, dust, dirt, etc. is expected.

Tools used in this occupation:

  • General office equipment
  • Office moving equipment
  • Forklifts (must have the ability to obtain a certification for safe handling every two years)
  • Hand tools
  • Material handling equipment
  • Wide range/size/type of vehicles

Technology used in this occupation:

  • Sponsor acquisition systems
  • Microsoft Office (i.e., Word, Excel, Access, Outlook)
  • Various Sponsor databases aligned to logistics activities (property, movement, purchasing, etc.).

Minimum Qualifications

Active TS/SCI Clearance with Polygraph

Experience:

Ten (10) years of relevant logistics experience in the public or private sector.

OR a minimum of 24 months, within last 3 years, of experience as a Logistics Generalist supporting a sensitive Sponsor program

Education:

High school diploma or GED equivalent.

Special Certifications:

Depending office of assignment, forklift certification maybe required

Depending office of assignment, HAZMAT certification maybe required or desired

Compensation Details:

US: $115,000 - $123,000 Annually

title: HR Strategy, Projects & Reporting Associate
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you're passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Role Purpose

The HR Strategy, Projects & Reporting Associate supports the Head of International HR in shaping and delivering the HR strategy and key functional priorities across EMEA and APAC. The role combines strategic support, project coordination, stakeholder engagement and reporting to ensure HR are driving key priorities. The role will play an important part in building compelling business cases, using data and insight to support decision-making and influence senior stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong all-round skill set, keen to make an impact and grow within a fast growing strategic International HR environment. This person will be comfortable moving between strategy development, project coordination, reporting, data analysis, and stakeholder support, and will enjoy bringing structure, insight, and momentum to key HR priorities.

Broadridge has strong international growth ambitions, both through expansion into new countries as well as through strategic acquisitions, creating an exciting and dynamic opportunity for someone who wants to help shape and scale a fast growing International Business.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning
  • Help identify strategic opportunities and initiatives across EMEA & APAC.
  • Partner with HR Leadership in developing, refining, and translating HR strategy into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.
Project Management & Delivery
  • Support the tracking and coordination of key HR priorities, strategic initiatives, and action plans across EMEA and APAC, ensuring clear milestones, ownership, and timelines are in place.
  • Monitor progress against agreed plans and proactively follow up with stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met.
  • Bring structure and discipline to cross-functional HR initiatives to drive execution and follow-through.
Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership Support
  • Work closely with HR Leadership to support engagement with senior stakeholders across the business.
  • Prepare high-quality materials; presentations, discussion papers, briefing notes, and other materials for leadership meetings and decision forums.
  • Support the Head of HR in key meetings, steering groups, and strategic discussions.
Reporting, Analysis & Business Cases
  • Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and updates on HR priorities, projects, and functional performance.
  • Gather, analyse, and interpret HR and business data to generate insights and support decision-making.
  • Build metrics and evidence-based analysis to support business cases, investment proposals, and recommendations.
  • Maintain accurate reporting packs, project trackers, and management information to support HR decision-making and regional planning.
Continuous Improvement
  • Identify opportunities to improve how the HR function plans, tracks, reports on, and delivers work.
  • Support the development of consistent frameworks, templates, and ways of working for strategy, reporting, and project execution.
  • Contribute to a high-performing HR team environment through a proactive, solutions-orientated, and collaborative approach.
Requirements

Experience
  • Minimum of 3-5 years within an HR function, ideally in a high-performing or complex International organisation.
  • Supporting strategic initiatives, projects, or functional planning within HR.
  • Preparing reports, dashboards, trackers, and presentations.
  • Working with data, metrics, and analysis to support recommendations and business cases.
Skills
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn ideas into structured plans and actions.
  • Excellent project coordination and organisational skills, with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Strong analytical capability, including the ability to interpret data and develop meaningful insights.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across different teams and locations.
  • Strong PowerPoint / presentation-building capability, with the ability to create clear, high-quality, executive-ready materials.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company-and ultimately a community-that recognizes and celebrates everyone's unique perspective.

title: Feature Producer I
description:
Job Posting Title:

Feature Producer I

10157689

Job Description:

Working at ESPN is unlike anything else. That’s because we’re always finding new ways to interact with fans – however and wherever they connect with sports. When you have the latest technology, game-changing ideas and world-class talent on your team, every day is extraordinary.

Proven and effective contributor to shows and production units as assigned by Producers and Coordinating Producers. Demonstrates superior creativity in assembling production elements including teases and features. Develops and produces show segments and stories using non-linear editing systems.

Responsibilities

  • Produces short-form and long-form feature stories and profiles across platforms such as SportsCenter, SC Featured, College Gameday, NFL Countdown, NBA Countdown, ESPN+, etc.

  • Generates, researches and pitches content/story ideas; determines the content, writing, editing style and storyline/narrative of features; arranges for talent, graphics, animation, equipment and crews; identifies storylines for narrative; writes script; oversees feature "shoots"; oversees editing to achieve the desired story arc and high-end production.

  • Plans and directs the work of freelance production personnel and freelance technicians during feature story productions. Ability to shoot/edit and knowledge of innovations in technology with cameras and edit is a plus.

  • Presents work for review to the responsible Vice President, Coordinating Producer or Senior Managing Producer at regular intervals and milestones.

  • Develops concepts and content for feature stories to reach viewers and increase ESPN's market penetration, television ratings, digital viewership, and social media reach.

  • Participates in decisions regarding the full scope of creative, content, production and cost/benefit decisions for assigned feature stories and profiles.

  • Recommendations and decisions are subject to general review and are guided by the defined objectives and outcomes of assigned feature stories.

  • Pushes the envelope creatively while working within confines of budget restrictions of particular feature or show.

  • Works independently without Talent when necessary or desired, conducting in-depth interviews and with well-written scripts.

  • Embraces and seeks knowledge of multi-platform content integration (digital/social media) and technological advances in field and post production.

  • Actively maximizes cross-platform potential of feature production.

  • Researches sports information and utilizes information resources in support of productions and to ensure accuracy.

  • Values our extensive video tape library and digital archive systems and proactively works to ensure important material is preserved in these systems.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of progressively complex related production experience with advanced prior experience reporting and producing features.

  • Has an ability to identify, create and write compelling feature stories and profiles, executing high-end video production from concept to completion.

  • Minimum 3 years of experience using non-linear edit software such as Avid and Adobe Premiere and able to produce rough cuts of segments for preliminary screening

  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment to turn feature stories around quickly for air.

  • Understands what content is compelling and relevant to shows, and actively suggests appropriate ideas.

  • Has strong research, reportorial/journalistic and storytelling skills.

  • Has strong communication and writing skills.

  • Proven ability to supervise effectively camera crews and editors; has demonstrated high-end, cinematic production skills with shooting, editing, audio/music, etc.

  • Has budget and resource management skills.

  • Specific knowledge of television production technique used in digital and social media.

  • Frequent travel to news gathering sights; availability to work weekends.

  • Demonstrated proficiency of working independently and remotely.

  • Use of various computer programs, including video editing programs and Photoshop, Microsoft Outlook, ENPS, NCS, various inter and intranet sites.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preference given to candidates with strong editing background, who can edit, color-correct, and provide final audio mix.

Required Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

Preferred Education

description:

You'll have...

Education:

Experience:

  • 5 + years of software engineering experience in the automotive industry, with a focus on quality, warranty analysis, or verification & validation.
  • 2+ Years of experience in software defect detection and prevention methodologies.
  • 2+ Years of experience in software design reviews to ensure compliance with architectural and quality standards.
  • 2+ Years of experience in Failure Mode Analysis (FMA) for software systems.

Experience:

title: Quantitative Trading & Research - Equity Derivatives Exotics - Analyst
description:
The Quantitative Trading & Research (QTR) Equity Derivatives team is looking for a junior quant to focus on exotic products. The objective is to drive and implement analytics, optimization and modeling for Equity Exotic trading, with immediate focus on building robust trade booking, analytics and model validation layers.

Job Summary

As an Analyst for the Equity Derivatives Exotics QTR team, you will make extensive use of quantitative techniques, including machine learning, to deliver end-to-end solutions for the business. This includes introducing a systematic framework to develop derivative products, strengthen risk and P&L control and facilitate lifecycle management, developing derivative pricing and lifecycle models, as well as identifying and monitoring associated model risks. It is particularly important for this role, that you are a disciplined developer, adhering to the highest standard of development, testing, deployment life cycle, working with the broader QTR team and with technology.

Job responsibilities:

  • Develop a framework and key components to develop derivative products including life cycling and model validation, using dependency-graph programming and Python language.
  • Model derivative products using C++ - Python hybrid programming to meet business requests.
  • Drive payoff innovation using the product design framework and machine learning techniques.
  • Streamline product review under the product design framework and provide clear model documentation to facilitate model approvals.
  • Evaluate quantitative methodologies including identifying and monitoring model risks associated with derivative valuation models.
  • Support trading activities by explaining model behavior, identifying major sources of risk in portfolios and carrying out scenario analyses.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Master degree in a quantitative field from a top university.
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Python and numerical packages
  • Experience with statistical analysis and machine learning.
  • Experience with derivatives pricing models and equity derivatives products.
  • Solid understanding of the application of Monte-Carlo simulation and finite-difference PDE in derivative pricing.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders.
  • Prior experience in a front-office quantitative research role.
  • Experience or good knowledge in dependency-graph programming.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Knowledge of risk management frameworks and regulatory requirements.

title: Sensing Systems Engineer
description:
The role

We are looking for a Sensing Systems Engineer to take ownership of the sensing subsystem across our vehicle platforms. This role sits within the Robotics team and operates at the intersection of AV Engineering, Hardware, Vehicle Software, Validation and Product.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our sensor stack and its integration into the vehicle platform meet the performance standards required for reliable model development and deployment. This includes defining clear requirements, building robust validation frameworks, and driving system-level decisions.

This is a cross-functional role focused on reducing ambiguity in sensing performance and enabling confident, data-driven decisions about vehicle readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own sensing system performance

    • Define what “good” looks like for the sensing stack in the context of model development, on-road performance and other applications using sensor data

    • Translate high-level product needs into measurable sensing requirements

  • Requirements & system definition

    • Develop and maintain clear sensing system requirements (e.g., sensing subsystem performance for both perception and localization sensors, calibration quality etc.)

    • Align requirements across Robotics, AV Product, Hardware, Vehicle SW and Automotive Product

  • System architecture & integration

    • Support Hardware and Vehicle Software teams to ensure correct sensor integration into the vehicle platform

    • Identify trade-offs and drive decisions on sensor configuration and system design

    • Provide consultancy on customers new vehicle programs on sensor requirements

  • Verification & validation

    • Design and implement frameworks to evaluate sensing system performance

    • Establish benchmarks and acceptance criteria for new vehicle bring-up

    • Diagnose and resolve sensor-related issues before they impact on-road behavior

  • Cross-functional leadership

    • Act as the central point of coordination for sensing across teams

    • Bring clarity to decision-making during ambiguous or fast-moving bring-up phases

  • Impact on ML systems

    • Evaluate how sensing quality affects model performance in real-world scenarios

    • Partner with ML teams to close the loop between data quality and model outcomes

About you

In order to set you up for success as a Sensing Systems Engineer at Wayve, we're looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in autonomous systems, robotics, automotive, or a closely related field, with direct involvement in real-world system deployment or vehicle bring-up

  • Strong systems engineering capability, including translating high-level product or model needs into clear, testable sensing requirements

  • Hands-on experience with at least one primary sensor modality (camera, LiDAR, radar), including integration into real-world platforms such as vehicles or robotic systems

  • Working knowledge of multi-sensor systems, including both perception sensors (camera, LiDAR, radar) and localization sensors (IMU, GNSS, wheel odometry)

  • Experience evaluating sensor performance and understanding limitations in real-world conditions

  • Experience defining metrics, benchmarks, and acceptance criteria for system performance

  • Experience working closely with multiple stakeholders such as Hardware, Vehicle Software, ML/Perception/Localization, and Product teams

Desirable

  • Experience in autonomous driving or ADAS systems

  • Practical experience with sensor calibration, time synchronization, and data alignment

  • Experience with vehicle platforms or embedded systems

  • Background in safety-critical or high-reliability systems

  • Experience on safety standards applied to AV, in particular SOTIF

This is a full-time role based in our office in Sunnyvale. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. The reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $276,000-$310,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

title: Amenity Services Program Manager

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Strong client focus, business management, and communication skills.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
  • Experience managing vendor teams and multi-unit operations.
  • 7+ Years of combined experience in strategy, transformation, or business case development, with direct exposure to real estate, hospitality, or amenity operations at scale.
  • Experience developing long-term strategies, managing projects, and integrating technology such as digital tools, mobile ordering, self-service kiosks, and contactless payment systems.

  • Strong interpersonal, relationship-building, crisis management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver executive-ready recommendations under tight timelines.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, in-person, high-visibility corporate headquarters environment.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Event Management Systems EMS or equivalent data platforms is a strong plus.

title: Project Manager
description:
Department Focus

The Design Value Stream function supports business needs and continuous improvement efforts through proper technical product and engineering principles as well as appropriate development of employees and management. The Design Value Stream is a business unit that encompasses quoting, engineering, quality, project management, production planning and procurement.

Summary

The Project Manager is an integral member of the Design Value Stream that works closely with the Design Value Stream Manager to ensure successful customer interface, execution, and shipment of technically challenging new and aftermarket engineered products.

Job Description and Duties:

Due to Federal Contract requirements, US Citizenship is required for this position.

Principle Duties

To act as the primary point of contact with the customer and is responsible for all communications and customer satisfaction after contract award.

Defines the scope of supply for awarded contracts, including the need for internal deliverables and customer submittals. The Project Manager shall collaborate with the Engineering Manager or Principal Engineer to establish milestones for each project and recommend high level work priority based on the milestone schedule. The Project Manager will be expected to understand status of assigned contracts throughout the engineering, job creation, procurement, manufacturing, testing and shipping stages.

Expected to interface and collaborate with different departments within the business to meet contract objectives, including Operations, Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, Sales, Test, and Engineering.

Negotiates changes to contract as required and identifies scope increase. Negotiation can include Terms and Conditions, submittals, delivery expectations, and pricing.

Executes communications plan to project requirements. Communications will include but are not limited to status on major materials, delivery status to original commitment date, risks associated with delivery and mitigation plan for those risks. Proactively documents delays, changes in scope and any other incidents that impact the scope of work or schedule.

Prepares monthly revenue forecast for the Design Value Stream in collaboration with the Design Value Stream Manager.

Understands and communicates task schedules to all project team members to ensure timely completion of project and when necessary, advocates for required project resources.

Foresees problems on contracts before they become problems.

Coordinates and chairs meetings to assure all planned activity occurs and that the quality of each event satisfies project requirements.

Manages multiple, parallel projects using formal project planning techniques.

Maintains contract file in accordance with established protocols and procedures.

Produces regular status reports containing assessments of contract status relative to cost, delivery, customer submittals, milestone completion, and risk.

Coordinates product packaging and shipping in accordance with contract requirements. Also ensures that progress payments and final invoices are executed on time.

Creates and maintains Health of Contract Report to monitor project performance to budget (margin expectations) and schedule including an "Issues List" in order to document all unplanned obstacles to satisfying the contract. All items must be resolved before contract can be formally closed.

Develops post-shipment contract review including assessment of cost, delivery, quality, and miscellaneous contract specific requirements. Improvement ideas for future contracts are communicated to the team for implementation based on this review.

Secondary Duties

Aids in development of project quotes, as needed. This can include milestone generation, timeline creation, risk assessment, review of commercial requirements, terms and conditions, and other activities.

Participates in the training and coaching of new and/or inexperienced team members.

Assists in developing department plans, goals, objectives, policies and procedures.

Other duties as required

Minimum qualifications:

  • Due to Federal Contract requirements, US Citizenship is required for this position.
  • BS in Engineering or Project Management or equivalent job experience.
  • 2+ years of experience managing government projects in a project/contract-based business preferred.
  • Experience in managing research and development projects in engineered products preferred.
  • Ability to read & interpret engineering drawings, standards and specifications
  • Ability to read & interpret purchase orders, terms and conditions, and customer specifications
  • Expected travel is up to 10% yearly
  • Proficient in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, MS Project and the Internet
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
  • Detail oriented and highly motivated
  • Possess high level of personal initiative
  • Able to facilitate geographically distributed and cross functional project teams

description:

The Director, Americas Brand Commercialization is responsible for leading and finalizing regional brand strategy for the Marvel and Star Wars portfolios across the Americas. Working closely with global brand partners and regional stakeholders, the role translates long-term franchise priorities into clear regional strategies that support brand growth, consumer engagement, and commercial objectives.

The role is responsible for setting strategic priorities and guiding the development of go-to-market frameworks. A critical component of the role is analyzing business performance, consumer trends, retail dynamics, and market opportunities to identify growth drivers, inform strategic decision-making, and shape future brand priorities. With a focus on long-range planning, the Director helps define the 24-month strategic roadmap for the region, ensuring brand strategies balance immediate opportunities with sustainable long-term growth.

As the senior regional brand lead for Marvel and Star Wars, the Director champions brand strategy across the organization, building alignment across category, retail, marketing, creative, finance, and global partners. The role serves as a key representative of the brand with senior internal stakeholders and strategic external partners, driving decision-making, prioritization, and execution against agreed business objectives. The role reports to the VP, Americas Brand Commercialization.

Responsibilities include:

  • Represent the franchise as a confident and engaging storyteller, delivering impactful presentations that build alignment, advocacy, and excitement.

  • Lead the development and finalisation of regional brand strategies and go-to-market frameworks for the Marvel, Star Wars, and 20th Century Studios portfolios across the Americas, balancing near-term priorities with long-term franchise growth opportunities.

  • Define and oversee the 24-month regional brand roadmap, ensuring alignment with global priorities, long-term planning objectives, and annual business goals.

  • Leverage business performance, consumer insights, retail trends, market dynamics, and competitive intelligence to identify growth opportunities, establish brand KPIs, and inform strategic decision-making.

  • Partner with Global Brand Commercialization teams and regional cross-functional stakeholders to shape franchise strategies, align priorities, and translate global direction into actionable regional plans.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to embed brand priorities and strategic initiatives into the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), mobilising teams around key content releases, franchise initiatives, and growth opportunities.

  • Serve as the senior regional brand steward for assigned portfolios, ensuring brand integrity, consistency, and strategic alignment across key initiatives, partner engagements, and consumer-facing experiences.

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with experience leveraging business performance, consumer insights, and market trends to inform decision-making and long-term planning.

  • Functional Skills:

The Mobile Inspector functions as a key member of the Manheim Mobile Inspections team, responsible for conducting on‑site vehicle condition inspections for dealer clients within an assigned territory. This role provides accurate, detailed, and timely documentation of vehicle condition in accordance with Manheim inspection standards, supporting client trust, marketplace transparency, and inventory flow.

Mobile Inspectors build strong relationships with dealer clients by delivering consistent, high‑quality inspections, acting as brand ambassadors for Cox Automotive, and actively engaging dealers to grow participation in Manheim’s mobile inspection services.

This role requires the ability to work with minimal supervision while demonstrating increasing independence, sound judgment, and problem‑solving skills.

Primary Responsibilities & Essential Functions

Vehicle Inspection & Documentation

Conduct thorough vehicle inspections in accordance with Manheim inspection standards.

Locate, start, move, inspect, and return vehicles safely on dealer client lots.

Verify vehicle identification, VINs, mileage, sub‑series, and options; ensure accurate system entry.

Inspect and document vehicle exterior condition, including tires, frame, glass, panels, and mechanical components.

Inspect and document interior condition, including seating, dashboard, and installed options.

Perform basic mechanical checks across powertrain, drivetrain, and electrical components.

Identify and document damage, missing components, or inoperable features.

Client Engagement & Territory Management

Build trust with dealer clients through consistent quality, professionalism, and responsiveness.

Educate clients on the value of Manheim Marketplace and mobile inspection services.

Proactively engage with dealers to increase inspection volume and maintain active participation.

Leverage data, insights, and partner input to maximize inspection efficiency and territory productivity.

Adapt to changes in daily appointments and schedules to ensure effective dealer coverage.

Reporting, Tools & Collaboration

Prepare and submit daily activity and production reports.

Utilize Salesforce.com for reporting, lead management, and customer performance tracking.

Collaborate closely with Wholesale Specialists, peers, and other Manheim teams to support client success.

Work effectively within a continuous improvement and Lean environment, contributing to process enhancement.

Safety, Compliance & Standards

Maintain production expectations as established by leadership.

Demonstrate a visible commitment to safety by following all safety and health procedures.

Participate actively in Safety Excellence initiatives.

Comply with Manheim inspection standards, including the NAAA Frame/Structure Damage Policy.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Ability to meet physical and mental demands of the role within required timeframes

Develop working knowledge of inspection standards and client expectations

title: Senior Research Scientist
description:
Job Title

Senior Research Scientist

Agency

Texas A&M University Health Science Center

Department

College Of Nursing

Proposed Minimum Salary

Commensurate

Job Location

Bryan, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

Our Commitment

Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service.

Who we are

As one of the fastest-growing academic health centers in the nation, Texas A&M Health encompasses five colleges and numerous centers and institutes working together to improve health through transformative education, innovative research and team-based health care delivery.

What we want

The Senior Research Scientist is responsible for overseeing and conducting complex independent scholarship in nursing and nursing education. This position provides scientific, strategic, and operational leadership for Project ConNECT, including oversight of research activities, collaborative partnerships, grant-related deliverables, dissemination products, and mentorship of project personnel and trainees. May collaborate with other scientists and/or faculty.

What you need to know

Salary: Will be commensurate based on the selected hire’s education and experience.

Location/Schedule: Bryan, TX/Part-Time

Please note: This position is grant funded; future employment may be contingent upon future funding.

We encourage you to apply! To help us learn more about your experience and interest in the role, please submit a cover letter and CV/resume. You can upload both documents in the CV/Resume section of the application.

Responsibilities
Research:

  • Oversees and conducts complex independent research and other sponsored activities related to Project ConNECT and professional nursing.

  • Provides scientific and operational leadership for Project ConNECT, including coordination of research priorities, timelines, deliverables, and study-related activities.

  • Leads or contributes to development of research protocols, grant proposals, progress reports, manuscripts, and dissemination products related to Project ConNECT.

  • Oversees project implementation in collaboration with faculty investigators, project staff, students, clinical partners, community partners, and sponsor representatives.

  • Ensures research and sponsored project activities are conducted in accordance with approved protocols, human subjects protections, data management expectations, sponsor requirements, and applicable institutional policies.

  • Analyzes data and summarizes results

  • Guides analysis, interpretation, and translation of findings for scholarly, clinical, community, and policy audiences.

  • Writes and may contribute to scholarly papers, articles, and publications.

  • Identifies opportunities for future funding, sustainability, and expansion of Project ConNECT’s purposes.

  • Assists with grant acquisition.

Mentoring/Supervision

  • Provides mentorship and scientific guidance to project staff, students, trainees, and collaborators engaged in Project ConNECT-related work.

  • Mentors and provides scientific guidance to students, trainees, project staff, and collaborators engaged in Project ConNECT-related work.

  • Supports professional development, role clarity, and continuity of project operations across interdisciplinary team members

  • May supervise assigned staff and/or students.

Presentations:

  • Represents Project ConNECT in meetings with academic, clinical, community, sponsor, and stakeholder audiences.

  • Disseminates findings through peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, professional presentations, community-facing materials, and other knowledge translation products.

  • Prepares and delivers presentations, reports, and dissemination materials for academic, clinical, community, sponsor, and stakeholder audiences.

  • Actively participates in the preparation of required technical progress reports to research sponsors.

  • Serves as a subject matter expert in rural nursing and nursing education.

Required Education and Experience

  • PhD in nursing or a related field.

  • Eight years of related experience in a specialized and relevant field of research.

Required Licenses and Certifications

  • Valid Registered Nursing license in the State of Texas

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading or co-leading federally funded research and other sponsored projects, including interdisciplinary team leadership, sponsor deliverables, grant development, scientific writing, and dissemination.

  • Experience with community-engaged, clinical, nursing, public health, health services, or implementation research.

  • Experience managing interdisciplinary research teams, external partnerships, research operations, and sponsor deliverables.

  • Experience with grant development, scientific writing, manuscript preparation, and dissemination to academic and non-academic audiences.

  • Familiarity with human subjects research, IRB processes, data integrity, and regulatory compliance in research settings.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent verbal and written skills.

  • Presentation skills.

  • Analytical skills.

  • Attention to detail.

  • Must be able to work independently as part of a multidisciplinary collaborative team.

  • Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others.

We are a prestigious university with strong traditions, Core Values, and a community of caring and collaboration. Protiviti is looking for a Technology Audit & Advisory Experienced Consultant to join our growing team.

What You Can Expect:

As an Experienced Consultant, you’ll be provided excellent training and meaningful mentorship to deepen your understanding of business processes and build technical skills. You’ll conduct interviews, compile, and analyze data, and document findings. Through interaction with client and project team personnel, you’ll develop professional relationships that contribute to exceptional client service. You’ll learn time and project management and take ownership of assignments.

At Protiviti, Technology Audit & Advisory focuses on:

  • Helping clients better manage risks associated with their use of technology, protecting and enhancing enterprise value.

  • Innovation: identifying solutions to client problems related to technology, helping them to rethink how technology processes are managed by incorporating AI and automation.

  • Technology enablement: Incorporating analytics, AI, automation and other new tools and methods in the execution of audit work for our clients, enabling a deeper, broader, more efficient, and more insightful analysis of our clients’ technology risks.

Consultants in Technology Audit & Advisory work with clients to assess, identify risk, advise, and consult on different technology-related topics, including:

  • IT General Controls (ITGC)

What Will Help You Be Successful:

Experience with or understanding of:

Exposure to and/or interest in:

title: Pool Maintenance (Third Shft)
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

The Pool Maintenance position is responsible for the testing, monitoring, cleaning, etc. of the college’s pool.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Vacuum pool at appropriate time as to not interfere with daily pool activities.
  • Perform all required testing four times a day, record and maintain clear records of testing on proper record keeping forms.
  • Back wash pool filters, monitor and adjust chemical feeding pumps.
  • Perform shock and buffer treatment to the pool, remove lane dividers from pool.
  • Maintain pool deck clean sweeps, mops and auto scrubs; keep deck clear of any items that could create safety concerns.
  • Maintain proper signage and emergency numbers visible in the pool area as required by state law; periodically check safety kits and remind athletic director of items that might have expired or need to be replaced.
  • Keep pool records and other items required by the State in an area that will be accessible by pool inspectors as they do frequent inspections throughout the year, at times without notice.
  • Request all necessary supplies and chemicals from housekeeping supervisor or manager in order to maintain the area.
  • Initiate all work orders relating to the pool.
  • Assist in draining and filling the pool, when necessary.
  • Perform other custodial duties, as assigned by the supervisor in accordance with the custodian’s job description.

WHAT EDUCATION AND SKILLS YOU WILL NEED

  • Certified pool operator with knowledge of state pool operating rules and regulations with working knowledge of pool chemical testing; will attend safety training as required by Management.
  • At least some related experience and/or training or an equivalent combination of education and experience and knowledge of mathematical equations.
  • Must be able to function well in a team/community environment, displaying common courtesies and politeness; frequently interacts with students, teachers, co-workers and administrators.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, material safety data sheets (MSDS), testing kits, mathematical skills and procedure instructions or manuals.
  • Ability to write out routine reports, fill out equipment logs and provide descriptions of problems and needs.
  • Ability to maintain a good working relationship with town board of health inspector, athletic department, the swim coach and students.

HOW AND WHERE YOU WILL WORK

Must have had a valid unrestricted U.S. Driver’s License for one year, and maintain throughout employment an insurable (as determined by the College’s insurer’s criteria) or a satisfactory driving record; must successfully complete and pass the College’s vehicle training program within the first 60 days of employment; annual or more frequent review of employee’s driving record based on the College insurer’s criteria; and safety training as required by management.

A. Physical Environment:

  • Regularly exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
  • Frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts; high precarious places; hazardous chemicals; outside weather conditions; and extreme heat.
  • Occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles.
  • Usually moderate noise level.

B. Physical Demands:

  • Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, feel, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Frequently required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, talk or hear, and smell.
  • Regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds.
  • Regularly climb and/or balance up to 10 feet and frequently climb and or balance up to 20 feet.
  • Regular use of close vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus

ADDITIONAL SKILLS YOU MAY HAVE

  • Two years of cleaning experience and pool maintenance desired.

This position is Sunday - Thursday from 10PM - 6:30AM

This is a union position with an hourly rate of $31.99. This position includes paid sick leave where required by law. Eligibility, accrual, and usage will follow applicable state and local regulations.

All questions or concerns about this posting should be directed to the Office of Human Resources at hr@babson.edu.

title: Senior Backend Python Engineer
description:
About NewtonX

NewtonX is a B2B insights company trusted by the world's most innovative companies to make high-stakes decisions with confidence. We combine a verified network of business professionals with AI-powered research tools to deliver research intelligence faster, more precise, and more defensible than traditional methods.

Our clients include Google, Microsoft, TikTok, DoorDash, Stripe, and Coinbase. Our research has been cited by Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, Adweek, and the Wall Street Journal.

NewtonX has raised $47M from investors including Two Sigma Ventures, Third Prime, XFund, and Citi Ventures.

The Role

As part of NewtonX's growing Medellín engineering hub, you'll design and build the fault-tolerant, modular systems that power our research platform — sophisticated APIs, large-scale queueing and streaming systems, and data processing pipelines. You'll work on a small, fast-growing engineering team (under 40 engineers) where individual contributors get in early and help shape the direction of our technology.

This role partners closely with US-based engineering leadership and cross-functional teams. Fluency and confidence in English, written and verbal, is essential — you'll participate in technical reviews, planning, and design discussions with colleagues across time zones.

Engineering & Delivery

  • Design and develop modular, reusable, production-grade applications.

Technical Contribution & Growth

  • Weigh in on architectural decisions with an eye toward scalability and maintainability.

  • Pair program and mentor junior engineers as part of a growing local team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Data, and US-based Engineering leadership on priorities and platform direction.

  • Communicate clearly and proactively across time zones, bridging any gaps between the Medellín and US teams.

  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and translate business priorities into well-scoped engineering work.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3–4 years minimum experience as a software engineer, with strong Python experience across multiple projects (tech stack: Python, Django, Django Rest Framework).

  • Hands-on experience developing web applications, including REST APIs.

  • Experience building asynchronous job-processing applications (e.g., Dataflow or similar).

  • Strong SQL experience with a common relational database.

  • Comfortable working with horizontally scalable systems (e.g., Kubernetes, EKS, ECS, or EC2 behind a load balancer).

  • Excellent English proficiency — clear, confident communication in writing and in cross-functional meetings with US-based leadership.

  • Bachelor's degree or greater.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Familiarity with Terraform, Cloudflare, or infrastructure-as-code.

  • Experience tuning PostgreSQL performance.

  • Full Stack Experience (Ideally in React)

Why Join NewtonX

  • Frontier B2B AI: Work on infrastructure powering the most sophisticated research and decision-making workflows in the world.

  • High ownership from day one: Get in early on a growing regional team with real influence over technical decisions.

  • Exceptional traction: Strong product-market fit with the world's largest investment banks, hedge funds, and consulting firms.

title: DogByte Senior Product Manager
description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most by challenging norms and fixing the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7/365, and created an ER experience that focuses on what our pets and pet parents really need. We’ve done the same for our people (VEGgies), finding a way to say YES so they are empowered to achieve great things, grow in unexpected ways, and find a place where they truly belong.

We’re rethinking emergency care from every angle—from how we run our hospitals to how we support the people working inside them. That’s where our headquarters team comes in. Whether building technology to make our hospitals more efficient, recruiting and growing incredible VEGgies, or bringing our brand to life through marketing, our VQ (VEG Headquarters) team makes it all possible—ensuring our hospitals and people have everything they need to help pets and their families.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

We’re looking for an experienced and self-motivated Product Manager for our proprietary clinical software - a practice management system (PIMS), we’ve lovingly named “DogByte”. In this role, you'll turn the needs of our hospitals, VEGgies, and patients into a clear product strategy and actionable roadmap. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, IT, Clinical, and Field Operations to build the product that our doctors, nurses, and hospital staff use every day to treat patients, save lives, and run our core business. You’ll function as the senior PM on a product team focused on bridging the gap between key corporate initiatives and the needs of our frontline VEGgies everyday. Your work will help raise the standard of care, unlock efficiency in our hospitals, and make the VEG Experience even stronger for the people and pets who need us most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Partner with veterinarians, nurses, and hospital staff to understand clinical workflows, translating their day-to-day pain points into clear product requirements.
  • Work with VQ stakeholders to build quarterly and yearly roadmaps that clearly communicate prioritization tradeoffs to the business.
  • Build strong relationships across Clinical, Field Operations, Customer Experience, Data, Growth, and VQ leadership to align product decisions with VEG strategic priorities.
  • Define and monitor key KPI that track the success of new initiatives and DogByte overall.
  • Collaborate with clinical and technical support teams to ensure new features land well in real hospital environments.
  • Write clear product specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that define the key requirements for new features.
  • Collaborate closely with design and engineering through the entire research, design, development, and launch lifecycle of new features.
  • Drive discovery through customer interviews, usage data, and support insights, validating problems and solutions before committing engineering resources.

title: Simulator Technician
description:
Job Description

Vill du arbeta praktiskt med avancerad flygsimulering och samtidigt bidra till en viktig förändringsresa? CAE Stockholm-Arlanda utvecklas till ett TCOP-center med ett antal flygsimulatorer samt kabinträning. Vi söker en flygsimulatortekniker som vill bli en del av ett tekniskt kunnigt team med ansvar för hög driftsäkerhet, kvalitet och myndighetsgodkänd träning.

Din framtid hos oss

Du som söker kan vara nyexaminerad, ha några års teknisk erfarenhet eller vilja byta till en mer specialiserad och spännande inriktning i arbetslivet.

Som flygsimulatortekniker arbetar du med förebyggande och korrigerande underhåll, felsökning och teknisk support på våra simulatorer samt vår träningsutrustning. Målet är att utrustningen alltid ska vara ”Ready for Training” för våra kunder.

Rollen innefattar även ansvar för att upprätthålla våra myndighetsgodkännanden. Det kan exempelvis innebära att genomföra regelbundna tester, granska resultat och assistera vid myndighetskontroller.

Vi erbjuder dig en utvecklingsplan samt utbildning som täcker stora delar av vårt verksamhetsområde. Vi söker dig som har intresse för flyg, teknik och problemlösning - och vill växa in i en framtida roll hos oss.

En verksamhet i förändring

CAE Stockholm-Arlanda befinner sig i en utvecklingsfas där verksamheten går mot att bli ett TCOP-center. Detta innebär ett tydligare fokus på drift, tillgänglighet och tekniskt stöd för en mer koncentrerad simulator- och träningsmiljö.

Ditt team kommer att ansvara för ett antal flygsimulatorer samt kabinträningsutrustning. Vår utrustning spänner över flera tekniska områden, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas inom exempelvis mekanik, elektronik, mjukvara, hydraulik, felsökning, dokumentation och kvalitetsarbete.

Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med kollegor, kunder, leverantörer och myndigheter. Du får en varierad vardag där både praktiskt arbete, analys och administration är viktiga delar av helheten.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

  • Utföra förebyggande och korrigerande underhåll på flygsimulatorer och träningsutrustning.

  • Felsöka tekniska problem inom bland annat elektronik, mekanik, mjukvara och hydraulik.

  • Säkerställa att utrustningen är driftklar samt uppfyller aktuella krav inför kundernas träning.

  • Genomföra regelbundna tester och dokumentera resultat enligt gällande rutiner.

  • Bidra vid myndighetskontroller, revisioner och uppföljning av teknisk dokumentation.

  • Samarbeta med teamet, kunder och leverantörer för att lösa tekniska och operativa frågor.

Arbetet innebär skift-tjänstgöring, vi har öppet dygnet runt, året om.

Kvalifikationer och meriter

Krav

Meriterande

  • Praktiskt handlag och intresse för teknisk felsökning

  • God datorvana och förmåga att arbeta strukturerat med dokumentation.

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.

  • Rätt att leva och arbeta i Sverige.

  • Ingenjörsexamen eller likvärdig teknisk bakgrund inom flyg, elektronik, mekanik eller mjukvara.

  • Erfarenhet av logik, kopplingsscheman och tekniska manualer.

  • Erfarenhet av hydraulik, mätutrustning och multimeter.

Vem trivs i rollen?

  • Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och tycker om att förstå hur tekniska system fungerar.

  • Du gillar att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.

  • Du är noggrann, lösningsorienterad och förstår vikten av säkerhet, kvalitet och dokumentation.

  • Du vill utvecklas i en roll där praktiskt arbete kombineras med teknisk analys och långsiktigt lärande.

Förmåner till dig som anställd

  • Friskvårdsbidrag

  • Hälsoförsäkring

  • Tjänstepension

  • Kollektivavtalade försäkringar

  • Aktieköp i företaget genom Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Rekryteringsprocess: Bakgrundskontroll, utdrag ur belastningsregister och tester är en del av vår rekryteringsprocess.

title: Controls Deployment Engineer, AMER US West Deployment
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated engineers, experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for innovating, deploying and optimizing the automation systems within the data centers. Automation systems consist of building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space.
You will also be able to grow your career on technical or management track.

As a Controls Deployment Engineer you will:
• Manage scope, and schedule of BMS and EPMS vendors during construction of AWS data centers.
• Develop scope of work for site improvement projects.
• Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate complex situations.
• Review controls sequence of operation and provide feedback to design.
• Financially manage BMS and EPMS construction contracts and assist in procurement related activities including RFQs, responding to RFIs, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
• Perform comprehensive review of various BMS and EPMS submittals.
• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.
• Ensure data center BMS and EPMS system are being deployed in accordance with scope of work (SOW) and specifications.
• Review and provide feedback on mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) drawings.
• Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls Management.
• Work under tight project timelines.
• Interpret controls drawings and wiring diagrams.
• Interpret controls bill of material (BOM).
• Understand and modify controls logic programming.
• Understand and modify graphical user interface.
• Support Controls related Commissioning activities in field.
• Frequently visit (locally) assigned under construction data centers to supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the design, submittal and applicable local electrical codes (NEC etc.).

title: Feature Systems Supervisor
description:
In this position...

Lead a team of Feature Systems Engineers within the Enclosures domain, driving the technical strategy, execution, and talent development needed to deliver next-generation Power Enclosure systems from concept through production.

The Feature Systems Engineering Supervisor – Enclosures leads a team of Feature Systems Engineers (FSEs) responsible for the architecture, development, and delivery of Power Enclosure features across the vehicle lineup. This role combines strong technical ownership of the Enclosures feature domain with people leadership responsibility — coaching, developing, and directing a team of engineers while remaining deeply engaged in the systems engineering work itself.

The Supervisor will translate customer and business requirements into robust technical solutions, ensuring the team's designs meet cost, quality, safety, and cybersecurity targets. They will act as the primary technical and people leader for the Enclosures FSE team, partnering closely with cross-functional core teams, program leadership, and the supply base to ensure features are delivered on time and to spec. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has both walked the systems engineering V-model themselves and can now guide others through it.

What you'll do...

  • Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of Feature Systems Engineers working in the Power Enclosures domain, including performance management, career development, and technical coaching.
  • Balance workload and assign features/projects across the team based on capability, capacity, and business priority.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture; recruit and onboard new talent as the team grows.
  • Serve as an escalation point for technical roadblocks, resourcing conflicts, and cross-functional disputes affecting the team.
  • Guide the team's systems architecture and development work, with a concentration on new technology in Power Enclosure systems, from early feature development through production launch, including feature upgrade and migration planning.
  • Ensure features and functions are allocated appropriately to meet cost, quality, and performance targets.
  • Oversee development of feature End-to-End and Component scenarios, Failure Mode Avoidance documentation, feature verification plans, functional safety assessments, and cybersecurity assessments/mitigations.
  • Guide the team through the use of Model Based Systems Engineering and software development practices (e.g., Python, C++) and requirement tools (e.g., Gherkin).
  • Review existing system designs across the team's portfolio to identify opportunities for cost or quality improvement.
  • Interact with product and program teams, core engineers, and functional areas to negotiate balanced solutions to challenging requirements.
  • Lead trade-off discussions with multi-functional teams and represent the Enclosures domain in program-level decision-making.
  • Communicate complex systems, issues, and resolutions clearly and concisely to engineering peers, leadership, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Apply connected data and data analytics to develop a deep understanding of customer needs and inform team priorities.

You'll have...

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, preferably in the automotive domain.
  • Prior experience leading, mentoring, or informally directing engineers or cross-functional project teams.
  • Strong understanding of vehicle electrical systems and/or features.
  • Functional knowledge of networking, power distribution, and body systems.
  • Demonstrated history of collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve software problems and CAN communication issues.

Even better, you may have...

  • Master's degree in Electrical Enginering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics or related field
  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering.
