title: Engineering Operation Technician
description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

title: Federal Background Investigator Analyst
description:
About Us

AdNet/AccountNet, Inc. is an 8(a), WOSB, and WBE-owned management consulting firm providing federal agencies with expert Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), diversity, and workforce support services.

Federal Background Investigator Analyst

Position Summary

The Federal Background Investigator Analyst provides investigative, intelligence, and analytical support for federal personnel security, suitability, public trust, civil, criminal, administrative, and regulatory investigations. This role involves conducting research, analyzing evidence, preparing investigative reports, and supporting agency personnel throughout the investigative process.

The contractor may be required to support sensitive investigative activities involving complex domestic and international allegations, including intelligence-gathering efforts and, when specifically authorized, undercover support activities.   • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Experience preparing clear, accurate, and objective reports and investigative summaries.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, research databases, and case management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal investigative, law enforcement, intelligence, Inspector General, regulatory, or personnel security programs.
  • Experience conducting OSINT research and analyzing complex evidentiary records.
  • Experience developing investigative timelines, charts, and evidentiary summaries.

Contractors must satisfy all applicable background investigation, citizenship, confidentiality, suitability, and security clearance requirements associated with the work and be able to maintain any required federal security credentials.

description:

You need to not only be a top software developer with excellent programming skills, an understanding of big data and parallelization, and a stellar record of delivery but also excel at leadership and customer obsession and have a real passion for massive-scale computing. If you want to truly test your mettle against the hardest challenges in distributed systems to build solutions for large scale problems in a wide variety of domains, come join our group.

Utility Computing (UC)

As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

- Develop new technologies for monitoring production clusters
- Own the software development process end-to-end, including: working with engineers and product managers to develop requirements; designing, architecting, planning, implementing, and testing new systems and features; deploying, and operating the production EMR systems.

About the team
About AWS

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

title: Emergency Department AOMC Sitter - FT Day Evening Rotation
description:
MAIN FUNCTION:

Provide observation to patients who require continuous observation. The primary purpose of this job position is to render routine daily observation and services to maintain the safety of the patient in accordance with the patient's rights and care plan and under the direction of a professional nurse. The Sitter reports directly to the Unit Director or designee.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


1. Refers the patient to the nurse or physician to answer any questions regarding care.


2. Monitors the patient's verbalizations and immediately informs the nurse if the patient expresses any idea or intention to hurt self/others or leave without physician's permission (elopement or Against Medical Advice {AMA}).


3. Observes the patient and maintains a safe environment, and as delegated by the RN, may provide care to the patient that does not interfere with the ability to maintain continuous visual contact. In accordance with training, responsible for maintaining the patient's safety which includes, but is not limited to, the following: providing CPR, keeping the patient from removing invasive lines, and keeping the patient from climbing out of bed.



4. Remains in the patient's room with an unobstructed view of the patient. Patient requests (that the sitter cannot accommodate/respond to) for assistance are promptly referred to the nursing staff via the phone or call light/intercom system.


5. Accompanies the patient for any clinical tests or procedures off the unit. Remains within an arm's length distance of the patient unless otherwise directed by the person performing the test or procedure.


6. Remains in the patient's room unless there is RN approval and/or qualified relief.


a. Waits outside the door if instructed to leave the room temporarily while the patient receives care.


b. Obtains RN approval to leave room if the patient's visitor requests that the sitter leave the room temporarily.


7. Turns on/off or adjust the station or volume on a radio or television only at the patient's request


8. If the patient is restrained:


a. Removes or adjust restraints only in an emergency, or if instructed to do so by an RN. Notifies the RN if the patient complains of discomfort or attempts to remove the restraint(s).


b. Ensures that the patient's dignity is preserved: patient is covered, curtains pulled, door adjusted to provide privacy.


c. Ensures that essential care needs are addressed (e.g., if upper limbs are restrained assist patient with facial tissue use, etc.)


9. In the event of an emergency or a sudden change in the patient's condition/behavior (e.g., medical emergency or escape attempt), notifies the RN immediately.


10. Feeds patients upon assessment and delegation by an RN.


11. Operates all equipment in a safe manner after receiving in-service on how to use equipment.


12. Reports defective equipment to Unit Director/Charge Nurse immediately.


13. Follows policies and procedures related to Standard Precautions.


14. Follows emergency protocols.


15. Promotes and fosters the mission and philosophy of the Hospital during performance of job duties and community activities.


16. Actively supports and participates in the Hospital Continuous Quality Improvement endeavors.


17. Maintains confidentiality of all patients/residents care information.


18. Maintains the rights of all patients/residents to independent expression, decision, personal freedom, dignity, and freedom from abuse or social isolation.


19. Provides privacy for patients/residents / knocks before entering the patient's room, closes door or curtain before performing procedures.


20. Reports patient/resident's complaints or grievances to Charge Nurse as soon as possible.


21. Is responsible for attending all annual mandatory educational programs as required by position.


22. Employee understands and demonstrates the importance of satisfying the needs of the customer/patient by interacting with him/her in a friendly and caring way, being attentive to the customer's needs, both psychologically and physically, and by taking the initiative to maintain communication with the customer in order to provide a secure and pleasant experience with the Arnot Health.


23. It is understood that this job description lists typical duties for the classification and is not to be considered inclusive of all duties which may be assigned.


EDUCATION:

High school diploma or equivalent experience required.


EXPERIENCE:

No experience required.


CARDIOPULMONARY RESUSCITATION (CPR) REQUIREMENTS:

BLS CPR required within 90 days of hire date.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

1. Good physical and mental health is required because long periods of standing and walking may be involved.

2. Frequently lifts 10 lbs and occasionally lifts 20 lbs.

3. Manual dexterity is necessary for feeding patient upon delegation to do so.

4. Visual and aural acuity are required to make adequate observations of patient's condition.


EXPOSURE CATEGORY:

Category I. Tasks that involve exposure to blood, body fluids or tissues.

Job Description

Basic Purpose:

Positions in this job family are assigned responsibility involving the coordination, supervision and direction of a correctional security program in a state adult correctional facility.

Typical Functions:

  • Coordinates and supervises or directs correctional security functions and activities at an adult correctional facility; may serve as a shift supervisor with responsibility for all assigned units and functions in a large facility or as the chief of security in a smaller facility.
  • May serve as commander of a correctional emergency response team; schedules training exercises and coordinates activities.
  • Conducts special investigations, particularly concerning incidents that occur during assigned shifts.
  • Coordinates and supervises security, riot and escape procedures, including procedures for inmate counts and searches for escape materials and contraband.
  • Prepares daily work schedules for security personnel; prepares and maintains appropriate records concerning employees and residents.
  • Conducts inspections of assigned staff at beginning of shift to assure proper attire and fitness for duty; makes periodic inspections of posts to assure that they are properly maintained; prepares administrative reports concerning the operation of the shift.
  • Acts as liaison to local law enforcement agencies; provides information and file changes; arranges court appearances.
  • Serves as member of the administrative institutional staff; participates in the formulation of institutional policies, rules and regulations.

Level Descriptor:

At this level employees serve as a correctional security lieutenant with primary responsibilities for the security operations on an assigned shift or unit within a minimum security facility or hospital security unit with responsibility for the supervision of first level supervisors who are responsible for individual units or activities on the assigned shift and coordination of all shift functions and operations. This level may also include supervisors of special units in a medium/maximum security facility such as a central control room, a gun gang crew, the house supervisor of a detention or restrictive housing or mental health unit and similar functions or may serve as the team commander of the Correctional Emergency Response Team.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required at this level include knowledge of supervisory methods and techniques; of staffing patterns and scheduling the distribution of staff and work assignments; of methods and objectives of discipline required for inmates under restraint; of the psychology of inmate behavior; of the use and care of firearms; of proper restraint methods and techniques; of the fundamentals of English usage; of basic math; and of report writing techniques.

Ability is required to establish and maintain effective working relationships; to follow oral and written instructions; to gather and organize facts and complete clear, concise reports; to quickly evaluate a situation and adopt an effective course of action; to exercise alertness and be able to act quickly in an emergency; to effectively communicate security techniques; to maintain proficiency in firearms; and to assess and manage conflict resolutions within the inmate population.

Education and Experience:

Education and Experience requirements at this level consist of three years of experience in correctional or security work for a government agency or private corrections agency and the following statutory requirements of Title 57, O.S. Section 510: a. The minimum age for service shall be twenty (20) years of age. The Director shall have the authority to establish the maximum age for correctional officers entering service and b. possession of thirty (30) semester hours from an accredited college or university; or possession of a high school diploma acquired from an accredited high school or GED equivalent testing program and graduation from a training course conducted by or approved by the Department and certified by the Council on Law Enforcement Education and Training either prior to employment or during the first six (6) months of employment.

Note: Successful completion of the GED test is based upon standards established by the Oklahoma Department of Education.

Special Requirements:

Per 57 O.S. 510 applicants/employees in this job family shall be subject to the following additional requirements: (a) be of good moral character; (b) before going on duty alone, satisfactory completion of an adequate training program for correctional officers and guards, as prescribed and approved by the State Board of Corrections; and (c) satisfactory completion of a physical in keeping with the conditions of the job description on an annual basis and along the guidelines as established by the Department of Corrections.

Applicants must possess a valid driver’s license at the time of appointment in order to perform necessary travel.

Applicants will be subject to drug testing.

Applicants must be willing and able to work any assigned shift or day of the week.

NOTE: Employees in this job classification may be designated as peace officers by the Director and required to meet the training and screening requirements conducted by the Department and certified by the Council on Law Enforcement Education and Training. (57 O.S. 510)

No person who has received a verdict of guilty or pled guilty or nolo contendere to any offense required to register pursuant to the Sex Offenders Registration Act is eligible for employment as a peace officer. (57 O.S. 589.C)

No person who has been convicted of a crime of moral turpitude who has not received a full pardon from the proper agency is eligible for employment as a peace officer. (70 O.S. 3311)

No person who has been convicted of a nonviolent felony and who has not received a full pardon from the proper authority, or who has been convicted of any other felony offense, is eligible for employment in this job classification. (21 O.S. 1283.B)

No person who has been convicted of a misdemeanor crime of domestic violence, who has not been pardoned for, or had the conviction expunged or set aside, or is subject to a court order that restrains the person from harassing, stalking, or threatening an intimate partner or the partners’ child or engaging in other conduct that would place an intimate partner or the partners’ child in reasonable fear of bodily injury and includes a finding that the person is a credible threat; or who has been dishonorably discharged from any branch of the armed services is eligible for employment in this job classification. (18 U.S.C. 922)

title: Footwear Rapid Prototyping Intern
description:
Who We Are:

Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.

JOB MISSION:

As a Footwear Rapid Prototyping Intern in the Inline Engineering team, you will support the operation of our 3D printing department, which is critical to the development of new products across all categories at New Balance.


You will plan daily printing schedules, prepare 3D files for printing, as well as operate various 3D print and post processing machines. You will optimize print settings and schedules to deliver high quality models in an efficient manner. You will also support inventory management and equipment maintenance. You will be an integral part of the product creation team at NB, interacting with a wide range of footwear professionals within your role.


As part of this internship, you will also have an opportunity to lead an engineering project within the inline engineering team. You will learn about footwear sole engineering, materials, costing, and manufacturing processes to help you deliver great results.


As part of your engineering project, you will gain valuable experience working with designers, developers, sports researchers, and product managers. You will also work across the company with innovation, materials, sourcing, quality, and legal teams.


You will learn new skills as New Balance continues to transform our product and processes to be more digital and drive great consumer experiences.


One year temporary assignment, Lawrence, MA (on-site 5 days a week)


MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES (RAPID PROTOTYPING INTERN):

  • 3D Printer operator – Key technologies include SLS and UV-curable inkjet printing
  • 3D Printer maintenance – Conduct routine maintenance such as cleaning, calibrating, and troubleshooting
  • Print queue management – prioritization of the queue based on urgency and available equipment, track in real time the progress and timing estimates
  • Model set up – preparing 3D data for printing, optimizing settings
  • Inventory management – tracking consumption and recommending material ordering schedules
  • Post processing – Perform post processing tasks such as immersion bath, waxing, water jetting, sand blasting, and glueing
  • Seeks information about advancements and trends in the industry – Help us shape the future of rapid prototyping at NB

MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES (ENGINEERING PROJECT):

  • Work with our cross functional teams to engineer new technical products that athletes and consumers love.
  • Works closely with the product teams to understand performance/consumer needs.
  • Communicate clearly and purposefully with overseas teams and partners to drive the products forward.
  • Exposed to a wide range of technical development issues including plastics engineering, molding, and costing.
  • Communicate and track development timelines to ensure milestones are met
  • Performs or directs the physical testing of engineered components


REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS:

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in engineering, material science, biomechanics, or related degree with an emphasis on consumer products and knowledge of 3D printing

description:
Job Description

Experiencia Requerida

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, transportation, logistics, carrier management, or a related supply chain function preferred.
  • Experience supporting logistics procurement portfolios with meaningful annual spend, multiple carrier/supplier relationships, high-volume transportation or warehousing activity, and measurable financial, service, or operational impact is preferred. ​

Habilidades

  • Demonstrated ability to operate with independent judgment in managing sourcing activities, supplier discussions, negotiation support, cross-functional alignment, and procurement recommendations with limited direction.
  • Experience in freight buying, contract logistics, warehousing procurement, contract review, supplier terms and conditions, or transportation category management strongly preferred; consumer products, manufacturing, food and beverage, or high-volume distribution experience is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of transportation contracts, supplier terms and conditions, insurance requirements, rate structures, indemnity and liability considerations, service commitments, and supplier qualification processes is preferred.
  • Experience with ERP, e-sourcing, transportation management systems, or spend analytics platforms is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of strategic sourcing, carrier procurement, supplier negotiations, contract review, contract administration, terms and conditions review, and total cost of ownership analysis across logistics spend categories.
  • Ability to analyze transportation rates, lane economics, accessorial charges, warehouse pricing models, and supplier performance metrics to support data-driven decisions.
  • Experience with RFI/RFP/RFQ events, bid analysis, supplier scorecards, savings tracking, and cross-functional project management.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills with the ability to influence internal teams and external suppliers.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with procurement, analytics, and transportation systems; experience with dashboards and reporting tools is preferred.
  • Understanding of transportation compliance, supplier risk management, service level governance, and continuous improvement methodologies.​

​

Resumen

The Logistics Procurement Sr Buyer is responsible for developing and executing logistics sourcing strategies and procuring logistics-related services that enable efficient, reliable, and cost-effective supply chain operations. This role supports procurement execution across a broad organizational scope, contributing to management of multimodal logistics spend, carrier and supplier capacity, freight volume, distributor service requirements, and network performance across Beer, Wine & Spirits operations. This position partners with Logistics, Transportation, Planning, Operations, Finance, Legal, and supplier stakeholders to secure capacity, optimize total landed cost, improve service performance, and mitigate supply and operational risk. The role owns competitive sourcing events, carrier and supplier selection recommendations, contract administration, supplier performance management, terms and conditions review, and continuous improvement initiatives across logistics spend categories while ensuring adherence to company policies, service requirements, and applicable transportation and trade regulations. The position influences organizational outcomes by supporting sourcing decisions, rate governance, contract compliance, productivity initiatives, and savings delivery across a network with significant annual spend, high-volume shipment activity, numerous carrier/supplier relationships, and measurable cost, service, and risk impacts. The position is expected to exercise independent judgment, influence cross-functional stakeholders, lead supplier discussions and negotiations, and provide coverage for higher-complexity procurement responsibilities as business needs require.

Responsabilidades

  • Lead sourcing and procurement activities for logistics categories including truckload, less-than-truckload, intermodal, parcel, drayage, warehousing, brokerage, packaging, and other transportation-related services as assigned.
  • Support sourcing and supplier management for a high-volume logistics network spanning distributor lanes, brewery-to-warehouse flows, intermodal and rail capacity, warehouse and 3PL services, and other transportation-related supplier relationships.
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies that balance cost, service, capacity, quality, and risk, with a focus on supporting network performance, on-time delivery, and supply continuity.
  • Manage competitive bid events including RFI, RFP, and RFQ processes; prepare bid packages, analyze responses, compare rate structures and service commitments, and recommend award decisions based on total value.
  • Negotiate transportation rates, accessorial schedules, service level agreements, fuel surcharge mechanisms, payment terms, and contract language to achieve competitive commercial outcomes and appropriate risk protection.
  • Provide support for Procurement Manager and Sr Manager, including managing escalated sourcing requests, preparing supplier recommendations, coordinating contract inputs, and maintaining continuity during workload peaks, absences, or business priority shifts.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with carriers, brokers, warehouses, and other logistics suppliers; support onboarding, qualification, performance reviews, corrective actions, and business reviews.
  • Monitor freight market conditions, carrier capacity, regional constraints, seasonal impacts, and cost drivers to identify sourcing opportunities, mitigate disruption risk, and inform procurement decisions.
  • Analyze spend, lane data, shipment profiles, supplier scorecards, and logistics KPIs to identify savings opportunities, improve network design decisions, and support budget planning and forecast accuracy.
  • Quantify and communicate organizational impact by translating spend, volume, supplier performance, service levels, capacity constraints, and network cost drivers into actionable recommendations for procurement and logistics leadership.
  • Partner with operations, logistics planning, customer service, finance, and legal teams to resolve supplier issues, align commercial terms with operational requirements, and ensure contracts are executable and measurable.
  • Administer contract lifecycle activities including contract review, drafting support, redlining coordination, review of supplier terms and conditions, renewals, amendments, pricing updates, and documentation of supplier obligations, insurance requirements, indemnity considerations, service levels, and other commercial terms.
  • Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and applicable transportation, trade, safety, and insurance requirements, and support audits, documentation standards, and supplier governance processes.
  • Support continuous improvement projects related to freight optimization, supplier rationalization, packaging efficiency, network redesign, and process automation to improve cost, service, and visibility.
  • Prepare reports and present recommendations on sourcing events, supplier performance, savings delivery, service issues, market trends, and risk mitigation actions to procurement and business stakeholders.
  • Track and report annualized savings, cost avoidance, productivity benefits, supplier commitments, awarded volume, and service/risk impacts to demonstrate measurable financial and operational value from sourcing events and supplier governance.

Applies documented procedures and policies to complete complex repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools Disassemble, inspect, clean and reassemble engines and /or engine components Performs preventative maintenance based on assessment of engines Assists more experienced technicians with diagnostics and development of repair plans engines in the workshop Completes required documentation, such as work completed documents, time sheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens Completes training in line with skill and business requirements Maintains work area and tools for cleanliness and proper operation Adheres to all relevant Health, Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to their supervisor

Competencies:

  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

  • Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

  • Situational adaptability - Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.

  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

  • Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

  • Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

title: Mobile Crisis Specialist
description:
For more than 60 years, PRS, now HopeLink Behavioral Health, has provided comprehensive and specialized support to individuals and families living with behavioral health challenges or facing a life crisis. SUMMARY STATEMENT OF POSITION:

The Mobile Crisis Specialist (MCS) is responsible for receiving, responding to, and triaging crisis and mobile crisis requests delivered via warm transfer from the Regional Crisis Call Center and 988. The MCS screens against the medical criteria for mobile crisis requests, ensures safety, coordinates care, and documents the interaction in a crisis data platform that creates dispatch requests. The MSC coordinates with the Clinician and Dispatcher team on shift.

  • Meaningful Work: Make a real difference in the lives of others.

SCHEDULE & LOCATION:

  • Shift Available: Monday -Friday, 10 am - 6:30 pm EST
  • Fully Remote

PRIMARY DUTIES:

  • Respond to incoming calls for mobile crisis response across all contracts within scope of employee work; completes outbound calls, to effectively coordinate care and resolve crisis situations; operate with accuracy, compassion, and efficiency.
  • Demonstrate effective engagement skills.
  • Screen incoming crisis requests resulting in safety and crisis resolution; effectively use the medical necessity criteria to guide crisis intervention based on acuity and risk.
  • Utilize knowledge of crisis continuum alternatives to MCR when a person does not qualify, resulting in crisis or contact resolution.
  • Participate in required training, supervision, meetings, and clinical oversight; demonstrates enhanced knowledge and skill over tenure, suicide intervention and prevention, the behavioral health system, mental health and diagnostics, community resources, effective communication, active listening, and contact center industry standards.
  • Demonstrate effective documentation skills; ensure all interactions are documented in the designated platform in accordance with policies, procedures, and industry or organizational standards of practice.
  • Adhere to call center policy and procedures.

ESSENTIAL COMPETENCIES:

  • Critical thinking and effective decision-making for managing high-acuity crisis requests and decision-making skills that facilitate safety and crisis resolution.
  • Demonstrates clear/concise/logical verbal and written business communication.
  • Plans effectively and adjusts effectively to new processes.
  • Builds and maintains collaborative relationships.
  • Technical, industry-specific knowledge about healthcare, behavioral health, crisis services, and clinical standards of practice; this includes knowledge of Medicaid managed care, behavioral health, crisis assessment and intervention, suicide intervention, recovery concepts, and community resources;

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master's degree in a human services-related field id required, Social Work or Counseling preferred.
  • Behavioral health professionals preferred
  • Experience with crisis intervention and contact center training is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with learners in a virtual environment.

NOTE: Crisis Services operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and 365 days a year. title: Quality Engineer — Omnichannel Order Execution
description:
Richemont, one of the world leaders in the luxury sector, has various Houses specializing in jewelry, watches and high-end accessories. Each Maison proudly embodies a tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont strives to preserve the heritage and identity specific to each of them. At the same time, we are committed to innovating and designing new products in line with the values ​​of our Houses, through a process of permanent creativity.

About the Team

Our team designs and delivers B2C Omnichannel Order Execution processes on SAP, integrated with external commerce platforms through an event-driven architecture (EDA).

The solution is built around a Solace message broker, which hosts the Canonical Data Model (CDM), and an SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) layer that translates and orchestrates data flows between SAP and external systems.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Quality Engineer to design and own the test automation framework for our integration landscape. The objective is to maximize automated test coverage, minimize manual testing, and ensure the reliability of CPI mappings and integrations as they evolve.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership, as the test automation capability will be built from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain an automated testing framework for the SAP CPI integration layer.
  • Validate that CPI mappings correctly implement Canonical Data Model (CDM) contracts and continue to function as expected as changes are introduced.
  • Develop automated regression and coverage tests to ensure integration quality.
  • Consume and validate Async APIs published through Kong for Solace pub/sub interfaces.
  • Build and maintain automated API tests using Insomnia and integrate them into GitLab-based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with the Test Automation Factory (TAF) team to align integration-layer and backend SAP testing efforts and avoid duplication.
  • Define and execute end-to-end testing strategies, plans, and test scenarios across the integration landscape.
  • Work iteratively in Agile environments, delivering early prototypes and continuously improving test automation practices.
  • Help define quality standards and testing best practices for the Omnichannel Order Execution platform.

Required Experience

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Strong understanding of test automation principles, including coverage, maintainability, and regression testing.
  • Experience with API testing and automation tools such as Insomnia, Postman, or similar solutions.
  • Familiarity with API management platforms such as Kong and Async API specifications.
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as Solace, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or IBM MQ.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based development workflows (GitLab, GitHub, etc.).
  • Exposure to SAP testing tools (e.g., Tosca) is advantageous.
  • Functional knowledge of B2C sales processes is desirable, particularly in areas such as payments, order fulfillment, logistics, delivery, and invoicing.

Working Style & Soft Skills

  • Self-motivated and able to independently translate high-level quality objectives into actionable test strategies and execution plans.
  • Comfortable working in Agile environments with iterative delivery and rapid prototyping.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and evolving requirements.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across engineering, testing, and SAP teams.
  • Structured and methodical approach to quality assurance and continuous improvement.

Education

No specific degree is required. However, candidates should demonstrate strong logical and technical reasoning abilities. A scientific or technical background is preferred, though equivalent experience gained through professional work, self-directed learning, or personal projects will also be valued.

title: Senior/Principal Turbomachinery Engineer
description:
About Endurance

Endurance is building the world's first modular subsea geothermal power plants, converting vast thermal resources under the ocean into gigawatts of baseload power. Backed by Founders Fund, Felicis, First Round Capital, and Point72 Ventures, our founding team includes veterans from SpaceX, Helion, Blue Origin, and Apple. We have completed multiple deep-ocean deployments to subsea volcanoes and are launching a long-term demonstration project this fall. By leveraging modular design, manufacturing scale, efficient drilling, and latent cooling on the seafloor, we are pioneering a new category of energy that outperforms traditional sources on environmental impact, deployment speed, and cost.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior or Principal Turbomachinery Engineer at Endurance, you will be the critical technical member of the team responsible for the core of our seafloor power plants. You will lead the design, analysis, and optimization of high-performance turbines and pumps specialized for compact power cycles.

This role requires a combination of strong first principles understanding of turbomachinery and a first principles hands-on approach to hardware. You will take turbomachinery designs from initial 1D sizing all the way to testing production designs in subsea deployments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Aero-Thermal Design: Own the design and optimization of turbines and pumps for power generation cycles.

  • Rapid Iteration: Use 1D/2D modeling tools for rapid sizing, trade studies, and system-level integration.

  • Numerical Simulation: Conduct high-fidelity 3D CFD analysis and structural FEA to ensure component performance and reliability.

  • Testing & Validation: Lead test campaigns to validate turbomachinery performance, correlate analytical models with experimental data, and identify failure modes.

  • Mechanical Integration: Integrate rotors, housings, bearings, and seals into robust, field-ready assemblies.

  • Tool Development: Establish internal modeling processes, design standards, and documentation to enable the team to scale.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering (Master’s or PhD preferred).

  • 3+ years of experience in the design, analysis, and testing of high speed rotating machinery (pumps, compressors, or turbines).

  • Strong fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer.

  • Experience with CAD software (e.g., Siemens NX) and rapid prototyping.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, "scrappy" startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with turbomachinery design tools such as AxStream, CFTurbo etc.

  • Proficiency in CFD and numerical simulation tools (e.g., ANSYS CFX/Fluent, OpenFOAM, or Numeca).

  • Experience with supercritical CO2 or organic Rankine cycle (ORC) turbomachinery.

  • Knowledge of high-pressure seal design and rotor dynamics.

  • Hands-on experience setting up and operating high-speed rotating equipment test rigs.

  • Programming skills (Python, MATLAB, or C++) for automated design optimization and data analysis.

Compensation, Benefits, & Perks

As a pre-revenue startup, Endurance Energy offers competitive base salaries and generous equity packages for full-time employees. Final base salary will be determined by an array of factors including internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and work experience.

A key aspect of our compensation philosophy is that value creation should be aligned with rewards. Right now this means equity is a significant portion of every full-time employee's compensation. As the company matures, there will be continued evolution and changes to the total rewards and total compensation package. What will always be true is that if we win, we win together. Equity is granted to every full-time employee as a meaningful piece of ownership. We believe the people building the company should share directly in the value they create.

In addition to a competitive base salary and equity, employees will receive all of our other great benefits and perks, including:

  • Benefits: Health, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage

  • Time Away: Flexible PTO including 12 paid company holidays

  • Global Fieldwork: Travel to fascinating deployment sites along oceanic ridges in locations like the Pacific Northwest, Hawaii, Iceland, Japan, New Zealand, and the Azores

  • Hands-on Experience: Participate in sea trials and deployment operations in partnership with leading oceanographic institutions

  • Cutting-edge Development: Work with technology that spans high-power electronics, marine systems, and clean energy

  • Impactful Work: Help solve one of the world's most pressing challenges

  • Dive Certification: Company-sponsored recreational dive certification

  • Other Perks: Access to the company boat, free meals and snacks, and the list goes on!

If you’re selected for consideration, a recruiter will be able to discuss in greater detail.

title: Senior Business Developer - Tech, Agentic Partner Transformation, Partner Core Foundations
description:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges. ASP is helping to dramatically accelerate that innovation, with more than 100k partners in more than 150 countries. AWS partners sit at the center of one of the biggest opportunities in enterprise technology: turning AI investment into real business outcomes. Our mission is to enable partners to fundamentally redesign how they operate around agentic AI — and then deliver that same transformation to their customers.



Key job responsibilities
We are looking for a Business Developer - Tech to help drive this transformation strategy. This is a builder role for someone who can work directly with partners to reimagine how they run their business with AI, prove what's possible through hands-on engagement, and design the model that scales those wins across the partner ecosystem. The specific mechanisms will evolve over time — what stays constant is the outcome we're driving toward: partners who don't just adopt AI tools, but achieve measurable business transformation and become a true extension of AWS field teams.

A day in the life
- Drive partner business transformation: Work hands-on with partners to reimagine their sales, delivery, and operational workflows around agentic AI — moving them from tool adoption to genuine operating-model change.
- Prove what's possible: Lead deep engagements that demonstrate measurable outcomes (deal velocity, pipeline growth, practice scale), building the case studies and evidence that inspire the broader partner base.
- Design for scale: Codify what works into repeatable approaches that others can run, and help build the model that turns transformed partners into a network that scales impact beyond 1:1 engagement.
- Partner across AWS: Collaborate with specialist organizations engineering teams, and field teams to bring a complete transformation offering to partners.
- Measure and iterate: Define success metrics, track outcomes, and continuously refine the transformation approach based on what drives real partner business impact.

About the team
The ASP Delivery team is responsible for scaling and delivering strategic initiatives designed to grow partners' business. The team drives consistent governance, delivery, and support across customer engagements, partner journey and program experience, funding and investments to partners, migration GTM and delivery success, MP feature and partner service adoption.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Global Banking & Markets Operations-Functional Design & Transformation-Dallas-Associate
description:
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals. For us, it’s all about bringing together people who are curious, collaborative and have the drive to make things possible for our clients and communities.

Team Overview

The Global Banking & Markets - Private (GBM - Private) Operations Transformation Office is seeking an associate to join the Functional Design & Transformation (FDT) team. FDT sits at the intersection of business strategy, operating model design, and technology delivery, driving front-to-back transformation across the GBM franchise.

In this role, you will lead complex, enterprise-scale initiatives from problem definition through implementation, designing future-state operating models and translating business strategy into actionable product and transformation roadmaps. Working closely with Operations, Sales, Trading, Engineering, and UX teams, you will shape scalable, user-centric solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

As an associate, you will operate as both a transformation strategist and product leader, partnering with senior stakeholders to define target states, align investment priorities, and drive execution. You will also lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of business architects, product and design practitioners, and transformation specialists, establishing the standards and frameworks that underpin successful transformation delivery across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

1. Transformation Strategy & Commercial Value Creation

  • Structure highly ambiguous business challenges into clear, hypothesis-driven workstreams with measurable success criteria.
  • Develop transformation theses, business cases, and investment strategies that support revenue growth, cost efficiency, risk reduction, control enhancement, and capital optimization.
  • Articulate a compelling commercial rationale for every initiative, quantifying expected value and defining clear ROI outcomes. Build defensible business cases and establish accountability for realizing projected financial and operational benefits.
  • Partner with business leaders to define multi-year transformation priorities, roadmaps, and sequencing aligned to strategic objectives.
  • Apply first-principles thinking to challenge legacy processes, identify root causes, and unlock step-change improvements.

2. Target Operating Model Design & Business Architecture

  • Lead the design of future-state Target Operating Models across organization, process, technology, data, governance, and workforce dimensions.
  • Develop functional architectures that connect business capabilities, processes, applications, data domains, and organizational structures.
  • Assess current-state operating models to establish baselines, identify pain points, and quantify improvement opportunities.
  • Conduct structured gap analyses and prioritize initiatives based on business impact, feasibility, and strategic value.
  • Define governance frameworks, decision rights, controls, and risk management mechanisms that enable sustainable transformation.

3. Product-Led Transformation Delivery

  • Own business outcomes, not just deliverables, establishing value hypotheses, success metrics, and benefit tracking mechanisms.
  • Translate operating model designs into product strategies, epics, user stories, and prioritized backlogs.
  • Drive prioritization decisions using business value, ROI, technical feasibility, operational risk, and user impact considerations.
  • Champion user-centered design through close partnership with UX teams and front-line users to improve adoption and experience.
  • Lead initiatives through execution and implementation, ensuring capabilities are delivered into production and successfully embedded within business operations.

4. AI-Enabled Transformation & Innovation

  • Identify opportunities to embed AI, automation, and intelligent workflows as foundational components of future-state operating models.
  • Design human-in-the-loop operating models that balance automation, judgment, risk management, and control.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, analysis, design, and delivery while maintaining analytical rigor.
  • Maintain deep awareness of emerging AI, GenAI, automation, and enterprise technology capabilities and their practical business applications.

5. Executive Stakeholder Management & Enterprise Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across Operations, Sales, Trading, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Control functions.
  • Bridge business, operational, and technology perspectives to drive enterprise-wide alignment and decision-making.
  • Develop executive-quality narratives, business cases, operating model designs, and steering committee materials.
  • Influence outcomes across matrixed organizations without direct authority, building consensus and removing execution barriers.
  • Lead governance forums, working groups, and steering committees to drive decisions and maintain transformation momentum.

6. Capability Building

  • Establish reusable methodologies, frameworks, playbooks, and accelerators that scale team effectiveness.
  • Drive sustainable adoption through change management, enablement, and capability transfer to business stakeholders.
  • Define and uphold the standard for world-class transformation, operating model design, and product-led delivery within the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience across management consulting, transformation strategy, operating model design, product management, business architecture, or related disciplines within financial services.
  • Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional transformation programs from strategy through execution with measurable business impact.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including business case development, financial modeling, value realization, and ROI measurement.
  • Deep expertise in Target Operating Model design across organizational, process, technology, data, and governance domains.
  • Strong product management discipline, including roadmap development, backlog prioritization, Agile delivery, and user-centered design.
  • Exceptional structured problem-solving and analytical capabilities, including hypothesis-driven analysis and data-informed decision-making.
  • Outstanding executive communication and storytelling skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and leadership forums.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships and drive alignment across complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing multidisciplinary teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years at a leading management consulting firm (MBB, Big Four Strategy, or equivalent) with financial services experience.
  • MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
  • Experience with business architecture methodologies, including capability modeling, value stream mapping, BPMN, TOGAF, or ArchiMate.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI/ML, intelligent automation, and GenAI technologies to business transformation initiatives.
  • Deep understanding of banking and capital markets operations, including trade lifecycle management, settlements, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting.
  • Experience leading change management, organizational adoption, and capability transfer programs.
  • Proficiency with visualization and collaboration tools such as PowerPoint, Visio, Tableau, Power BI, Figma, and Miro.
  • Direct experience within GBM Operations, middle office, settlements, confirmations, or related capital markets functions

ABOUT GOLDMAN SACHS

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

JOB TITLE: Salty Processing Operator

JOB TYPE: Intermediate Level General Labor

LOCATION: Hanover, Pennsylvania

GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION

The Salty Processing Operator, under general supervision, is responsible for the safe, efficient, and continuous operation of processing machinery while maintaining continuous flow of product to the packaging lines. Responsibilities include making minor adjustments to the machinery to achieve the correct product, troubleshooting, maintenance of machinery, and record keeping.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Operates the processing equipment to produce product within guidelines established by Quality Assurance and to the highest possible standard of quality.

• Properly mixes ingredients; monitors correct temperature/moisture and adjusts; accordingly, monitors product and removes any product that is improperly formed or overlapped.

• Operates and shuts down equipment in the processing area in accordance with established procedures to include change overs and preventative maintenance.

• Communicates and/or escalates quality issues to appropriate team members.

• Reads and understands batch sheets including following recipes and accurate weighing of raw materials.

• Monitors and logs current temperatures, mix times, item numbers, and raw material weights (piece weights of extruded product) and adjusts accordingly.

• Monitors for possible foreign matter.

• Follows sanitation procedures for clean ups and change overs, including chemical handling.

• Tracks and disposes of waste accordingly.

• Moves raw ingredients using material handling equipment including but not limited to forklift and/or pallet jack.

• Always maintains proper raw material levels, unload raw materials trailer, and keeps appropriate personnel updated in raw material needs.

• Maintains inventory usage and proper disposal of cutter blades. Responsible for always securing blades and keeping Urschel Heads running efficiently.

• Tests and receives new oil; treat, filter and test used oil. Maintains the proper level of oil in processing equipment.

• Maintains thorough understanding of heat exchanger system.

• If applicable, monitors correct seasoning coverage amount, adjusts accordingly.

• Practices and adheres to appropriate safety and hygiene guidelines/procedures for safe housekeeping/5S and personal protection; keeps work area clean; stores supplies in designated areas; keeps work area aisles/exits clear and free from obstructions; removes trash from work area floor; follows instructions for safe lifting/carrying of various sizes, shapes, and weights of objects; identifies/reports defective equipment; reports all job-related injuries to supervision.

• Mandatory overtime may be required.

• May perform other duties as required.

QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE JOB

Education: High School Diploma or GED is preferred, but not required.

Experience: 1-year production experience in a manufacturing environment is preferred, but not required.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

Dartford, Kent

title: Fellow/Senior Fellow, Market Shaping Accelerator
description:
The Center for Global Development (CGD) is an independent, non-partisan, non-profit policy research organization in Washington, DC, and London, UK that focuses on the issues and institutions that are critical to inclusive development. Through rigorous empirical research and active engagement with the global policy community, CGD focuses on the intersections between the policy and financial priorities of low- and middle-income countries and the governments, institutions, and corporations that can be partners in delivering greater progress.

Founded by Rachel Glennerster, Michael Kremer and Christopher Snyder, the Market Shaping Accelerator (MSA), housed at CGD, aims to catalyze the development of advance market commitments and other market shaping mechanisms to incentivize innovations addressing pressing global challenges including in the areas of global health, pandemic preparedness, climate, AI safety, and drug repurposing. Information on MSA’s current projects can be found on our focus areas webpage. We focus on driving innovation in areas of large social value but incommensurate commercial return in both low- and high-income country settings by identifying promising opportunities, developing high-impact proposals, and engaging with policymakers and funders.

MSA is hiring for a position based in Washington D.C. that may be filled at either the Fellow or Senior Fellow level, depending on the successful candidate's qualifications and experience. We welcome applications both from economists finishing a PhD and from those with several years of post-PhD experience. We are looking for candidates with expertise in economics and a strong interest in market shaping, pull incentives, and innovation policy. The successful candidate will have policy or research experience at the intersection of economic theory, industrial organization, market design, innovation policy, and/or related applied policy research. This position is a good fit for candidates with a strong desire to apply insights from their research to the design of real-world pull mechanisms and advance innovation policy more broadly.

The fellow/senior fellow will develop and implement a research agenda on how market shaping mechanisms can align private incentives with social value to accelerate innovation for global public goods. This work may include designing and evaluating pull mechanisms—such as advance market commitments, prizes, milestone payments, and other outcome-based funding models—in areas where commercial returns fall short of social benefits, including in global health, pandemic preparedness, climate, AI risk/safety, and other high-value innovation priorities. The work involves policy design both domestically and internationally.

The fellow/senior fellow will sit on the MSA team and lead this work. They will also be one of a wider group of CGD fellows they liaise with and contribute to, engaging external audiences and supervising research assistants on discrete tasks.

Responsibilities include:
  • Design and lead a research agenda that combines economic modeling, quantitative analysis, institutional knowledge, and practical policy design to inform market-shaping mechanisms and generate actionable recommendations
  • Help mobilize funding for MSA’s work on market shaping and innovation policy
  • Represent MSA externally through speaking engagements, blogging, and public and private convenings, and engage at a high level with key individuals and groups in the donor, policymaker, and technical/domain expert communities
  • Publish reports, papers, policy briefs, and short, timely commentary that incorporate quantitative findings targeted to policymakers, philanthropic funders, the development community, and CGD’s public audience
  • Provide analytical support to colleagues’ research, and supervise and mentor associate staff

All candidates should have the following qualifications and skills:
  • A PhD in economics, completed or expected before the start date, with training in economic theory, industrial organization, market design, innovation economics, or a related subfield
  • A Keen interest in policy impact and a demonstrated ability to take a policy project from ideation through to execution
  • Strong analytical training, including facility with microeconomic theory, applied modeling, quantitative analysis, and the ability to build simple, transparent models that translate technical economic ideas into policy-related recommendations.
  • Judgment in identifying high-impact policy and economic questions, a commitment to translating research into concrete policy outcomes, and a pragmatic understanding of the objectives and constraints policymakers operate under
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex findings for diverse audiences, as well as high-level organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently within a small, closely-knit organization and to contribute to the development of new institutions

For the Senior Fellow position, we are looking for the following additional qualifications:
  • At least five years of relevant experience beyond the PhD, with a distinguished body of work in the program area
  • Prominence in the area of market shaping/innovation policy and strong professional relationships across the relevant research, policy, and funding communities
  • A track record of generating external financial support for research programs
  • Experience managing complex research and policy projects and supervising or mentoring junior colleagues

Closing date: Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. However, candidates will be reviewed and invited for virtual interviews on two cycles: the first review deadline is Nov 1, 2026, and the second review deadline is February 1, 2027. The position will close March 1st, 2027, at 11:59 ET.

Salary range:
Fellow: $130,000 - $150,000 per annum.
Senior Fellow: $170,000 - $190,000 per annum.
Pay commensurate with education, skillset, and experience.

Interested candidates should submit (1) a cover letter indicating which level you are applying for and describing your interest in joining the MSA team and your experience with market shaping, innovation policy, industrial organization, market design, or related economic-policy analysis, (2) a writing sample such as a research paper that demonstrates your analytical writing skills—either a published or working paper (an additional policy-facing piece of 500–1,000 words is also welcome) and (3) a CV.

We manually review applications; no AI or automated filters are used to screen candidates.

The organization is working in a hybrid environment with all staff required to be in the office at least three days per week. CGD is registered to employ staff living in DC, Maryland, and Virginia. Candidates must be able to declare a primary residence in one of these 3 locations.

In compliance with United States federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document upon hire. CGD will sponsor United States work authorization for this position. Any offer of employment requiring sponsored work authorization is contingent on CGD and the candidate’s ability to successfully petition for and secure the necessary work visa(s).

title: Technical Business Analyst - Emerging Technology & Innovation
description:
Be Here. Be Great. Working for a leader in the insurance industry means opportunity for you. Great American Insurance Group's member companies are subsidiaries of American Financial Group. We combine a "small company" culture where your ideas will be heard with "big company" expertise to help you succeed. With over 30 specialty and property and casualty operations, there are always opportunities here to learn and grow.

At Great American, we value and recognize the benefits derived when people with different backgrounds and experiences work together to achieve business results. Our goal is to create a workplace where all employees feel included, empowered, and enabled to perform at their best.


This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

We’re hiring a Technical Business Analyst to join our Emerging Technology & Innovation team. This high-ownership role is ideal for someone who can turn ambiguity into direction, research emerging capabilities, and help move early-stage ideas into structured opportunities, product backlogs, and scalable technology-enabled solutions.

The role works at the intersection of business insight, technical analysis, and product direction, with a focus on AI, automation, cognitive intelligence, IoT, property intelligence, digital image forensics, and inspection technologies. This individual will help identify opportunities, evaluate emerging technologies, guide Proofs of Value (PoVs), and support the transition of validated concepts into scalable business capabilities and enterprise solutions.

Great American’s culture is built on connection, shared learning, and strong relationships. This is a hybrid role that combines in-office and remote work. Employees are expected to maintain a meaningful on-site presence to support collaboration, relationship building, and business success.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery, Research & Product Planning

  • Engage business stakeholders to understand workflows, challenges, and opportunities for technology-enabled improvement.

  • Research emerging technologies, vendor capabilities, and market trends to identify practical innovation opportunities.

  • Translate broad ideas into clear problem statements, opportunity briefs, user stories, process flows, and actionable backlog items.

  • Lead opportunities from initial concept and Proof of Value (PoV) through evaluation, business case development, and transition into scalable product, platform, and operational solutions.

  • Continuously monitor emerging technology trends, startup ecosystems, vendor innovation, and industry developments while helping maintain and evolve the Emerging Technology Radar to support strategic planning and investment decisions.

Technical Collaboration & Delivery Support

  • Partner with product, engineering, architecture, data, automation, vendor, and business teams to define MVP scope, requirements, dependencies, and success measures.

  • Support pilots, Proofs of Value (PoVs), and implementations from concept through launch, helping guide successful initiatives from experimentation into enterprise-scale adoption while maintaining alignment to business value, operational outcomes, and user needs.

  • Use AI-supported analysis, structured visuals, and practical recommendations to help stakeholders evaluate emerging capabilities and solution fit.

  • Facilitate collaboration across stakeholders to remove ambiguity, align priorities, and ensure technology initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Coursework or certifications in business analysis, product management, agile methodologies, or user-centered design are a plus.

Experience

  • 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role, preferably in Property & Casualty insurance.

  • Experience translating ambiguous business needs into actionable requirements, product direction, and delivery-ready backlog content.

  • Experience participating in or leading Proofs of Value (PoVs), pilot programs, innovation initiatives, or emerging technology evaluations, including helping transition successful concepts into production-ready capabilities.

  • Strong collaboration skills across business, product, technical, and vendor teams in agile environments.

  • Experience using AI-enabled tools, research methods, and platforms such as Rally, Power BI, Visio, or similar tools is preferred.

Skills

  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Ability to connect emerging technologies to practical business problems and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong aptitude for evaluating emerging technologies, identifying business applicability, and communicating recommendations regarding experimentation, adoption, scaling, or retirement.

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving clarity, and taking ownership in a fast-paced innovation environment.

  • Curious, self-directed, and creative in applying AI, automation, data, imagery, and emerging technologies to real business challenges.

Business Unit:

Property & Casualty IT Services
