location: Remote, Colorado, United States of America
description:
Job Description

As Global Director of Sales Operations, you will help lead the transformation of Zendesk’s GTM operating model by redesigning workflows, embedding AI and automation into core business processes, and improving operational effectiveness across the customer lifecycle.

This role goes beyond traditional Sales Operations. You will help design and implement new approaches to how work gets done, leveraging AI, automation, and modern GTM tooling to solve problems more effectively and drive measurable business outcomes. This includes designing and operationalizing intelligent AI agents and agent-assisted workflows that augment GTM teams, automate execution, and improve decision-making across the customer lifecycle.

We are looking for a hands-on builder, someone who is comfortable operating at both the strategic and execution level, willing to get into the details, and able to iteratively design, test, and refine solutions. You will leverage AI, automation, and modern GTM tooling to solve problems more effectively and drive measurable business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain AI agents and agentic GTM experiences that support sellers, managers, and customer-facing teams through intelligent task execution, workflow orchestration, conversational guidance, and autonomous or semi-autonomous operational workflows.

  • Lead the evolution of an AI-first GTM operating model, driving operational excellence, workflow redesign, and scalable automation across the customer lifecycle.

  • Own and prioritize the GTM systems and automation roadmap, translating business needs into scalable solutions that connect data, workflows, AI, and automation to improve execution and productivity.

  • Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives focused on process improvement, AI adoption, workflow standardization, and scalable operational change across the GTM organization.

  • Establish governance and operating standards across GTM systems, data, and workflows, including intake, approvals, change management, data stewardship, and responsible use of AI and automation.

  • Enable efficient and scalable deal operations and GTM launches, embedding automation and intelligent guidance into approval, pricing, execution, and launch-readiness workflows.

  • Lead and develop a team of GTM operations specialists, fostering accountability, continuous improvement, and the design and iteration of AI-powered solutions.

  • Operate with a structured, iterative delivery model, managing prioritization, sprint-based execution, cross-functional alignment, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Partner across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Data, and IT to drive adoption, align priorities, and lead cross-functional transformation initiatives across the GTM organization.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Automation, Systems, Strategy, or related roles within high-growth B2B environments, including experience leading operational or technical teams.

  • Proven ability to lead large-scale, cross-functional transformation initiatives that improve operational effectiveness, execution quality, and business performance.

  • Strong systems-thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable operational and technical solutions.

  • Experience designing and operationalizing AI-enabled and agentic GTM workflows across areas such as sales engagement, lead routing, prioritization, sequencing, next-best actions, guided selling, forecasting, AI-assisted execution, conversational copilots, and autonomous workflow orchestration.

  • Experience building or supporting AI-powered productivity workflows, including automated sales collateral generation, business case creation, customer-facing content, and rep enablement processes.

  • Experience working with modern automation, orchestration, and AI tooling (e.g., Make, n8n, Zapier, Workato, Clay, Claude, Codex, Cortex, or similar platforms) to improve productivity and streamline execution.

  • Familiarity with modern GTM tooling ecosystems, including CRM, sales engagement, conversational intelligence, forecasting, enrichment, and workflow automation platforms.

  • Strong understanding of data governance, enrichment, and signal-driven operating models, with experience improving data quality, operational reliability, and business decision-making.

  • Experience operating within iterative or agile delivery environments, managing prioritization, cross-functional execution, and continuous improvement across complex initiatives.

  • Ability to operate effectively across strategic and executional levels, partnering with executive, business, operational, and technical stakeholders to drive alignment, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

Who You Are

  • You think in systems, understanding how data, workflows, tooling, automation, and AI connect to drive effective GTM execution.

  • You are energized by building and improving how work gets done, not simply maintaining existing processes.

  • You focus on measurable outcomes and business impact, holding yourself and your team accountable for execution and results.

  • You are comfortable operating across levels, from executive strategy discussions to hands-on problem-solving with operational and technical teams.

  • You operate with a bias toward action, iterating quickly, navigating ambiguity effectively, and continuously improving workflows and processes over time.

  • You think beyond static workflows, designing intelligent and adaptive agentic experiences that combine AI, automation, data, and human guidance to improve GTM execution and scalability.

  • You value operational rigor, including clean data, scalable processes, clear documentation, and reliable systems that support frontline teams effectively.

  • You understand that successful transformation requires strong change management, ensuring new capabilities are not only launched, but adopted and used effectively.

title: AVP, Data Center & Large Load Strategy - Commercial
description:
Are you looking for an exciting job where you can put your skills and talents to work at a company you can feel proud to be a part of? Do you want a workplace that will challenge you and offer you opportunities to learn and grow? A position at Xcel Energy could be just what you’re looking for.

AVP, Data Center & Large Load Strategy - Commercial

Position Summary


The AVP of Data Center & Large Load Strategy will guide the development and execution of strategic initiatives to integrate AI-driven large-scale data center and other large load customers onto the electric grid. The Data Center and Large Load Strategy team plays a critical role in successfully positioning Xcel Energy as the trusted and preferred utility provider amidst rapidly growing load requirements and national competition to attract large loads. The initiatives led by this group represent a significant opportunity for company investment with benefits for existing customers and attracting high levels of investor interest. The role requires deep expertise in regulatory frameworks, commercial negotiations, infrastructure planning, and stakeholder engagement. This role serves as a cross-functional leader, driving alignment across regulatory, operations, planning, and customer-facing teams to ensure timely and cost-effective load growth. This role will focus on the Customer Pipeline & Relationship Management and Commercial Negotiations & Risk Management aspects of the role and will have a peer focused on Regulatory and Ratemaking Strategy/Resource & Infrastructure Planning.

Essential Responsibilities

Customer Pipeline & Relationship Management

  • Build and manage relationships with prospective data center customers.
  • Evaluate prospective partners for viability, and risk, translating insights into load forecasts and financial plans.
  • Set and maintain clear expectations with customers and internal stakeholders on deliverables, timelines, and utility capabilities.

Commercial Negotiation & Risk Management

  • Influence and advise on negotiations with data center and other large load customers.
  • Maintain close understanding and balance risk related to commercial viability, financial risk, existing customer impact, and regulatory approval requirements.

Regulatory & Ratemaking Strategy

  • Partner with Operating Companies to lead regulatory strategies for large load tariffs and Energy Services Agreements (ESAs).
  • Support incremental cost tests and develop tariff structures aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Assess stakeholder sentiment and regulatory feasibility to ensure ESA and other contract approvals

Resource & Infrastructure Planning

  • Collaborate with Integrated System Planning (ISP), Corporate and Project Development, and Operations to execute transmission and distribution studies and ensure generation resources are available to meet new load needs.
  • Align on and enable timely infrastructure buildout to support load ramp-up schedules.
  • Align internal resources to meet reliability and cost targets.

Internal Leadership & Matrix Management

  • Lead a highly matrixed team across regulatory, engineering, planning, and customer functions.
  • Drive short-timeline, high-impact initiatives with clear accountability and cross-functional coordination.
  • Cultivate internal networks to accelerate decision-making and execution.

Technology & Innovation Strategy

  • Leverage advanced technologies to meet Company and customer reliability and carbon goals.
  • Identify and implement creative front-of-the-meter (FTM) utility solutions to minimize incremental costs.
  • Stay abreast of emerging technologies in AI, energy, data center operations, and other market trends.

Strategic Reporting & Executive Engagement

  • Maintain close understanding of and report progress, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Develop presentations and updates for executives, the board of directors, and investor audiences to support strategic decision-making.
  • Represent Xcel Energy in external forums and with key stakeholders

Minimum Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in utility operations, regulatory affairs, and/or corporate/project/business development.
  • Proven track record in leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of utility ratemaking, tariff design, and regulatory approval processes.
  • Experience negotiating large commercial agreements.
  • Familiarity with transmission/distribution planning and infrastructure development.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strategic thinker with ability to manage ambiguity and drive results.

As a leading combination electricity and natural gas energy company, Xcel Energy offers a comprehensive portfolio of energy-related products and services to 3.4 million electricity and 1.9 million natural gas customers across eight Western and Midwestern states. At Xcel Energy, we strive to be the preferred and trusted provider of the energy our customers need. If you’re ready to be a part of something big, we invite you to join our team.

Job Description

Basic Purpose:

Positions in this job family are assigned responsibility involving the coordination, supervision and direction of a correctional security program in a state adult correctional facility.

Typical Functions:

  • Coordinates and supervises or directs correctional security functions and activities at an adult correctional facility; may serve as a shift supervisor with responsibility for all assigned units and functions in a large facility or as the chief of security in a smaller facility.
  • May serve as commander of a correctional emergency response team; schedules training exercises and coordinates activities.
  • Conducts special investigations, particularly concerning incidents that occur during assigned shifts.
  • Coordinates and supervises security, riot and escape procedures, including procedures for inmate counts and searches for escape materials and contraband.
  • Prepares daily work schedules for security personnel; prepares and maintains appropriate records concerning employees and residents.
  • Conducts inspections of assigned staff at beginning of shift to assure proper attire and fitness for duty; makes periodic inspections of posts to assure that they are properly maintained; prepares administrative reports concerning the operation of the shift.
  • Acts as liaison to local law enforcement agencies; provides information and file changes; arranges court appearances.
  • Serves as member of the administrative institutional staff; participates in the formulation of institutional policies, rules and regulations.

Level Descriptor:

At this level employees serve as a correctional security lieutenant with primary responsibilities for the security operations on an assigned shift or unit within a minimum security facility or hospital security unit with responsibility for the supervision of first level supervisors who are responsible for individual units or activities on the assigned shift and coordination of all shift functions and operations. This level may also include supervisors of special units in a medium/maximum security facility such as a central control room, a gun gang crew, the house supervisor of a detention or restrictive housing or mental health unit and similar functions or may serve as the team commander of the Correctional Emergency Response Team.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required at this level include knowledge of supervisory methods and techniques; of staffing patterns and scheduling the distribution of staff and work assignments; of methods and objectives of discipline required for inmates under restraint; of the psychology of inmate behavior; of the use and care of firearms; of proper restraint methods and techniques; of the fundamentals of English usage; of basic math; and of report writing techniques.

Ability is required to establish and maintain effective working relationships; to follow oral and written instructions; to gather and organize facts and complete clear, concise reports; to quickly evaluate a situation and adopt an effective course of action; to exercise alertness and be able to act quickly in an emergency; to effectively communicate security techniques; to maintain proficiency in firearms; and to assess and manage conflict resolutions within the inmate population.

Education and Experience:

Education and Experience requirements at this level consist of three years of experience in correctional or security work for a government agency or private corrections agency and the following statutory requirements of Title 57, O.S. Section 510: a. The minimum age for service shall be twenty (20) years of age. The Director shall have the authority to establish the maximum age for correctional officers entering service and b. possession of thirty (30) semester hours from an accredited college or university; or possession of a high school diploma acquired from an accredited high school or GED equivalent testing program and graduation from a training course conducted by or approved by the Department and certified by the Council on Law Enforcement Education and Training either prior to employment or during the first six (6) months of employment.

Note: Successful completion of the GED test is based upon standards established by the Oklahoma Department of Education.

Special Requirements:

Per 57 O.S. 510 applicants/employees in this job family shall be subject to the following additional requirements: (a) be of good moral character; (b) before going on duty alone, satisfactory completion of an adequate training program for correctional officers and guards, as prescribed and approved by the State Board of Corrections; and (c) satisfactory completion of a physical in keeping with the conditions of the job description on an annual basis and along the guidelines as established by the Department of Corrections.

Applicants must possess a valid driver’s license at the time of appointment in order to perform necessary travel.

Applicants will be subject to drug testing.

Applicants must be willing and able to work any assigned shift or day of the week.

NOTE: Employees in this job classification may be designated as peace officers by the Director and required to meet the training and screening requirements conducted by the Department and certified by the Council on Law Enforcement Education and Training. (57 O.S. 510)

No person who has received a verdict of guilty or pled guilty or nolo contendere to any offense required to register pursuant to the Sex Offenders Registration Act is eligible for employment as a peace officer. (57 O.S. 589.C)

No person who has been convicted of a crime of moral turpitude who has not received a full pardon from the proper agency is eligible for employment as a peace officer. (70 O.S. 3311)

No person who has been convicted of a nonviolent felony and who has not received a full pardon from the proper authority, or who has been convicted of any other felony offense, is eligible for employment in this job classification. (21 O.S. 1283.B)

No person who has been convicted of a misdemeanor crime of domestic violence, who has not been pardoned for, or had the conviction expunged or set aside, or is subject to a court order that restrains the person from harassing, stalking, or threatening an intimate partner or the partners’ child or engaging in other conduct that would place an intimate partner or the partners’ child in reasonable fear of bodily injury and includes a finding that the person is a credible threat; or who has been dishonorably discharged from any branch of the armed services is eligible for employment in this job classification. (18 U.S.C. 922)

The Department of Corrections has determined that some positions in this job family are safety sensitive as defined by63 O.S. § 427.8

Blackpoint Cyber is the leading provider of world-class cybersecurity threat hunting, detection and remediation technology.   • Deliver projects across our stack — TypeScript/Node.js, Python, and Go services hosted on Kubernetes — flexing between data engineering and general backend work as priorities shift.

  • Leverage your deep understanding of design and architecture, along with best practices in design patterns. Your experience in optimizing for performance, scale, and resiliency will help deliver outcomes that withstand the test of time.

  • Excel as a team player by recognizing the importance of diverse perspectives and managing expectations and needs across numerous cross-functional groups. This includes mentoring other engineers on day-to-day technical and design questions.

Champion the responsible use of AI to automate routine tasks, improve engineering workflows, and boost system reliability and team productivity.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in backend and data engineering, with demonstrated expertise delivering scalable, high-performance systems in fast-paced, enterprise-level environments.

  • Experience with message- and event-driven architectures using tools like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other event-streaming systems to build highly scalable, decoupled services.

  • Expertise in designing and consuming APIs (REST, GraphQL, or gRPC), with a focus on creating secure, scalable, and high-performance services.

  • Commitment to data quality and observability — pipeline testing, monitoring, alerting, and lineage — with hands-on experience using Prometheus and Grafana to maintain system performance and health.

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies on AWS (e.g., Lambda, S3, EKS/ECS, Kinesis, SQS) and designing for cost-efficient operation at scale.

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, or similar), automating testing, deployment, and scaling of services.

  • A deep understanding of security best practices, such as securing APIs, handling sensitive data, and managing authentication/authorization (OAuth, JWT).

  • Strong desire to work in a fast-paced, start-up environment with multiple releases a day, and experience working in an Agile development environment — leading sprint planning, breaking down large initiatives, and aligning team efforts with business objectives.

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proven track record of diagnosing complex issues, devising effective solutions, and implementing innovative approaches to overcome technical challenges.

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous code quality, security review, and architectural integrity.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with security data at scale — EDR/endpoint telemetry, network logs, SIEM data, or similar high-volume event streams.

  • Experience with Elasticsearch or similar search engines for building robust indexing and search capabilities in backend services.

  • Expertise in security best practices, including penetration testing and vulnerability assessment, to safeguard applications against potential threats.

  • Experience evaluating and integrating LLM-based capabilities or AI features into production SaaS products, including considerations around prompt security, output validation, and responsible AI disclosure.

title: NVIDIA AI Infrastructure Global Architect
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.

F5 is transforming how organizations deliver, secure, and operate modern applications and AI infrastructure. BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes (BNK) is F5's cloud-native platform for Kubernetes networking, application delivery, and security. As AI Factories rapidly scale across Neoclouds, AI-Native Platforms, Hyperscalers, and Foundation Model providers, F5 is building a specialized team of industry experts to shape the future of AI infrastructure.

The NVIDIA AI Infrastructure Global Architect serves as a senior technical leader, industry strategist, and trusted advisor for customers building next-generation AI platforms. Operating at the intersection of AI infrastructure, networking, security, and business transformation, this role partners with strategic sales, product, engineering, and leadership teams to accelerate customer adoption of F5 solutions within NVIDIA-powered AI environments.

What You'll Do

Serve as the AI Infrastructure Thought Leader

  • Act as F5's senior technical authority for NVIDIA-based AI Factories, GPU clouds, and large-scale AI infrastructure.

  • Provide strategic guidance to customers on AI platform architecture, scalability, networking, security, and operational excellence.

  • Influence customer technology roadmaps through technical advisory engagements and architecture strategy sessions.

Engage Senior Technical Stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with Architects, platform engineering leaders, infrastructure leaders, technical decision makers, and senior customer stakeholders.

  • Translate complex technical challenges into measurable business outcomes, helping customers optimize AI investments and accelerate time-to-value.

  • Lead technical workshops and strategic discussions around AI infrastructure modernization.

Drive Technical Strategy and Business Growth

  • Partner closely with Account Executives, Strategic Sales Leaders, and Alliance Teams to develop account strategies and technical win plans.

  • Support large, strategic opportunities by aligning F5 and NVIDIA technologies to customer initiatives.

  • Shape business cases that demonstrate the value of secure, scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure.

Architect AI Factory Solutions

  • Design and validate architectures for AI Factories, GPU-as-a-Service platforms, Kubernetes environments, and multi-tenant AI infrastructure.

  • Advise customers on networking, traffic management, ingress/egress, service delivery, security, and workload optimization for large-scale AI deployments.

  • Develop architectures leveraging NVIDIA BlueField DPUs, DOCA, GPU networking, and cloud-native application delivery platforms.

Lead Industry and Ecosystem Engagement

  • Represent F5 at customer events, technical briefings, conferences, industry forums, and partner engagements.

  • Collaborate with NVIDIA field teams, alliance partners, and ecosystem stakeholders to create differentiated solutions and go-to-market strategies.

  • Serve as a visible thought leader through whitepapers, presentations, technical content, and industry discussions.

Influence Product and Engineering Direction

  • Act as the voice of the customer for AI and NVIDIA-related requirements.

  • Translate customer needs, competitive insights, and emerging market trends into actionable feedback for Product Management and Engineering.

  • Help shape future roadmap priorities for BNK and AI infrastructure solutions.

Develop Repeatable Solutions and Best Practices

  • Create AI Factory reference architectures, deployment models, technical playbooks, and operational frameworks.

  • Establish best practices for Kubernetes networking, AI workload delivery, and infrastructure security at scale.

  • Mentor Solutions Architects and Technical Sales teams on NVIDIA ecosystem technologies and AI infrastructure trends.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, Systems Engineering, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Architecture, or related customer-facing technical leadership roles.

  • 5+ years of experience working with cloud-scale infrastructure, AI/ML platforms, high-performance computing (HPC), or GPU-accelerated environments.

  • Demonstrated experience engaging senior technical decision makers and customer stakeholders.

  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes, cloud-native architectures, container networking, and application delivery technologies.

  • Strong knowledge of data center networking, including Layer 2-7 technologies, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, RDMA, and high-performance fabrics.

  • Experience designing solutions involving NVIDIA AI infrastructure, BlueField DPUs, GPU networking, DOCA, or related ecosystem technologies.

  • Proven ability to influence technical strategy across customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and senior stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working directly with NVIDIA, hyperscalers, AI-native platforms, or GPU cloud providers.

  • Familiarity with AI Factory architectures, large language model (LLM) deployment environments, and distributed AI training infrastructure.

  • Experience developing technical business cases and technology transformation strategies.

  • Public speaking experience at industry conferences, technical forums, or customer briefings.

  • Knowledge of AI infrastructure security, multi-tenancy, workload isolation, and data sovereignty requirements.

Skills & Competencies

Technical Leadership

  • Strong technical presence with the ability to advise and influence senior business and technology leaders.

  • Ability to bridge strategic business objectives with complex technology solutions.

AI Infrastructure Expertise

  • Deep understanding of AI Factory architecture, GPU infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, and cloud-native networking.

  • Expertise in large-scale AI workload delivery and infrastructure optimization.

Strategic Consulting

  • Ability to identify customer challenges, define technology strategies, and build transformation roadmaps.

  • Strong consultative and outcome-focused approach.

Ecosystem Influence

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across customers, partners, alliances, sales, product management, and engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of the NVIDIA ecosystem and emerging AI infrastructure trends.

Technical Excellence

  • Ability to simplify and communicate highly complex architectural concepts to both business and technical audiences.

  • Proven success driving technical validation, architecture design, and strategic technology adoption.

Why F5?

As the NVIDIA AI Infrastructure Global Architect, you will help shape the future of AI infrastructure and GPU cloud computing. You will work directly with the world's largest AI innovators, hyperscalers, Neocloud providers, and enterprise AI leaders while influencing the intersection of AI, networking, security, and cloud-native infrastructure. This is a unique opportunity to serve as both a strategic advisor and technical visionary helping build the next generation of AI Factories at global scale.

Key Differentiator of this Role: Beyond traditional Solutions Architecture responsibilities, the NVIDIA AI Infrastructure Global Architect serves as F5's senior AI infrastructure expert, industry evangelist, strategic advisor, and NVIDIA ecosystem leader.

title: IT Specialist II
description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

Relay’s IT team builds and maintains the systems, tools, and workplace technology that help our people do their best work. As an IT Specialist II, you’ll provide reliable day-to-day support, help maintain our Toronto office, and contribute to projects that improve how Relay operates. You’ll bring strong technical fundamentals, a service-first mindset, and the ability to make an impact from day one.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Provide thoughtful, timely support to Relayers across hardware, software, identity, access, connectivity, and workplace technology.

  • Own a regular portion of the IT support queue, independently troubleshooting and resolving issues while escalating appropriately.

  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access changes, laptop setup, and first-day technology readiness.

  • Procure, configure, deploy, track, and maintain laptops, peripherals, and other IT equipment throughout their lifecycle.

  • Support the day-to-day technology needs of Relay’s Toronto office, including meeting rooms, video conferencing, displays, networking, and shared workplace systems.

  • Help administer SaaS and IT platforms such as Google Workspace, Iru, Okta, Slack, Atlassian, Notion and more.

  • Maintain clear documentation, asset records, troubleshooting guides, and internal knowledge-base content.

  • Identify recurring issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend improvements that reduce friction and improve reliability.

  • Automate routine tasks and help improve IT processes as Relay continues to scale.

  • Contribute to larger IT initiatives and independently lead smaller projects, workstreams, or project tasks.

  • Partner with Security, People, Workplace, Engineering, and other teams on cross-functional technology needs.

  • Help create an exceptional employee experience by making support approachable, dependable, and continuously 1% better.

Who You Are

  • You have 3–5 years of IT support or IT Operations experience in a business or corporate environment.

  • You can join an established environment and become productive quickly without foundational training in professional IT systems or support practices.

  • You have hands-on experience with, MDM systems, identity and access management, ticketing systems, and business collaboration tools.

  • You’re experienced supporting macOS and Apple hardware in a managed corporate environment.

  • You can independently troubleshoot complex hardware, software, identity, networking, and connectivity issues.

  • You understand SSO, MFA, access permissions, least privilege, and secure onboarding and offboarding practices.

  • You have familiarity with office networking platforms such as Ubiquiti, Meraki, Fortinet, Cisco, or Aruba.

  • You’re comfortable supporting Google Meet, Zoom, and meeting-room technology.

  • You can manage multiple requests, prioritize effectively, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical teammates.

  • You’re organized, curious, service-oriented, and motivated to improve systems rather than only react to problems.

  • You’ll be on-site at our downtown Toronto office a minimum of 3 days per week, typically Tuesday through Thursday.

  • You embody a hands-on mindset and don’t hesitate to roll up your sleeves when needed.

Bonus Points

  • A background working in startups, high-growth environments, or at another fintech.

  • Experience creating automations that reduce manual work or improve IT service delivery.

  • Familiarity with zero-trust environments and modern endpoint-security practices.

  • Exposure supporting office expansions, network deployments, or meeting-room installations.

  • Experience leading smaller IT projects and working with Agile delivery frameworks, including two-week sprints using Scrum or a similar approach.

Physical Requirements

This role may involve physical activities such as lifting and moving materials up to 25 pounds, bending, stretching, reaching, frequent walking, and setting up technology throughout the office, all within reasonable accommodation.

The Interview Process

  • Stage 1: A 30-minute Google Meet video call with a member of our team

  • Stage 2: A 60-minute Google Meet video call with the Hiring Manager

  • Stage 3: A 60-minute Live Session with the Hiring Team

  • Stage 4: A 45-minute Google Meet video call with a member of our leadership team

Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.

The annual salary range for this role is $90,000 CAD to $110,000 CAD.

For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $100,000 CAD. Offers below this point reflect candidates we believe can grow into the full scope of the role with support and development. Offers above this point reflect impact that meaningfully exceeds the role’s defined expectations or an expanded scope from day one.

We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub.

Why Relay Might Be the Perfect Fit For You

  • You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.

  • You crave autonomy: We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’re someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.

  • You own your work: You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

  • You build with AI, not just use it: You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.

  • You care about impact, not noise: You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself.

  • You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity: You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.

  • You seek out feedback: You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.

  • Small businesses are why we're here: Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.

Join Us

We're looking for people who are relentless, curious, and care deeply about the work. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description -- your perspective and drive matter more. We welcome diverse backgrounds and people who think critically, challenge the status quo, and want to help small businesses thrive.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the hiring process, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

Disclaimer: For compliance reasons, all offers of employment at Relay are conditional upon a successful background check and employment verification through Certn.

title: Engineer
description:
Career Area:

Engineering

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Join Caterpillar as a Component Design Engineer – Large Engine, you will have the opportunity to concept, develop, and design complex components and systems while strengthening your analytical skills and mastery of engineering concepts within the cylinder head, engine block, and housing team. You will partner with and provide technical guidance to global teams. You will contribute to the development of diesel, natural gas, and alternative fuel reciprocating engines serving a variety of customers across the world. You will contribute to the planning and delivery of projects, continually learn and stay abreast of innovative technology, mentor and coach team members, and broaden your professional network. You will work with engineers, agency employees, manufacturing, global purchasing and suppliers to design / release / validate core engine components in support of current and future programs/projects.

What You Will Do

  • Design of core engine components as a part of a global team that include heads, blocks, and housings.
  • Partner with manufacturing, purchasing, quality, marketing, and engineering teams to deliver solutions that meet customer and dealer requirements.
  • Perform root cause analysis and structured problem solving to address manufacturing and product issues.
  • Technical evaluation of product design, reliability, durability, validation cost, product cost and meeting program requirements
  • Apply New Product Implementation (NPI) processes to conduct FMEAs (Failure Mode Effects Analysis), formulate validation plans, and complete the validation activities
  • Evaluate new products, processes, or systems including supplier change requests
  • Complete projects on time and at cost in support of NTI (New Technology Introduction), NPI, CPI (Continuous Product Improvement) and NSI (New Supplier Introduction) programs
  • Communicate results to customers, suppliers, team members, and other business units
  • Leadership of supplier collaboration and CPPD (Continuous Product & Process Development)

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Materials Science, or a related accredited technical curriculum.
  • Advanced English-speaking level is required.

Required Skills

Engineering - MFG

  • Knowledge of manufacturing readiness, production launch activities, tooling implementation, process improvement, and engineering change implementation.
  • Ability to support manufacturing operations, engineering processes, and production efficiency initiatives.

Analytical Thinking

  • Knowledge of structured problem-solving methodologies and continuous improvement practices.
  • Ability to perform root cause analysis and utilize tools such as Pareto charts, fishbone diagrams, process maps, and corrective action documentation.
  • Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop effective corrective and preventive actions.

Technical Excellence

  • Knowledge of computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) software, computer-aided design (CAD) tools, manufacturing equipment, and related production technologies.
  • Ability to apply technical expertise to improve manufacturing processes, product quality, and operational efficiency.

Effective Communications

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, Product Engineering, Suppliers, and Operations.
  • Ability to communicate technical information, project updates, and problem-resolution plans to stakeholders at multiple levels.
  • Ability to build strong working relationships and coordinate activities across functional areas to achieve business objectives

Additional Information:

  • This position will be in Cienega de Flores, Nuevo Leon
  • This position is five-days a week subject to changes and willingness to work sporadically on weekends.
  • Requires working weekends, based on business continuity needs.
  • Domestic relocation assistance is available for this position.
  • This position may require up to 15% travel. (international and domestic)
  • Do not forget to include a resumé in English in your profile in Workday.

Final details:

The Caterpillar Code of Conduct states that we will select, and place employees based on their qualifications for the job to be performed, without regard to race, religion, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age or disability. In this company we do not request pregnancy tests, nor HIV tests as requirements for employment entry, permanence or promotion.

agosto 7, 2026 - agosto 21, 2026

Great Lakes Wine & Spirits is Michigan's Largest Alcoholic Beverage Wholesaler, servicing all 83 Michigan counties. Employing over 1,000 people with facilities throughout the state, We Are Local, Everywhere. Founded as a family business nearly 80 years ago, the tradition of good business principles has remained the cornerstone of Great Lakes Wine & Spirits success. Honesty, hard work, fair dealing, service and an ongoing commitment to the customers and staff. Great Lakes Wine & Spirits strives to provide an ever-escalating standard of innovation and service to its customers and to responsibly enhance demand for its products.

Great Lakes Wine & Spirits continues to grow as we seek a Merchandising Swing Representative for our Retail Chain Sales Division servicing multiple accounts in and surrounding areas of Clinton Township.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The Merchandising Swing Rep is responsible for the timely stocking and product handling of all GLWAS merchandise shipped to an assigned (designated) retail account. This includes packing out all orders, pricing the individual bottles, building displays, resetting shelf schematics, resetting cold box schematics, and implementation of the correct shelf and display signage, rotation, product fronting, dusting, and adherence to all shelf and other housekeeping standards. Other duties include but not limited to:

  • All shelf price tags are correct and in place at the beginning of every month.
  • All display prices are correct and placed with current pricing.
  • Maintains and places all current POS for all products.
  • Maintains and uses reports, forms, and pre-plans

Work Schedule

The Merchandising Swing Rep is a full-time position with daytime hours varying by schedule Monday through Friday. Evenings and weekend hours may be required based on holiday schedules and business needs.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

This position operates in the field with daily travel, driving in all weather conditions. Physical demands require to frequently stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch, stoop and climb throughout the day while lifting, stacking, moving, and rotating items without handles that weigh up to 50 pounds. Pushing and pulling carts with up to 100 pounds of force and operating warehouse equipment may be needed.

title: RN, House Supervisor - Full-Time - Ukiah Valley
description:
Adventist Health Ukiah Valley has been deeply connected to the community we serve since 1956. We are comprised of a 50-bed acute care medical center, level IV trauma center, level II intensive care nursery services, extensive physical rehabilitation program, outpatient surgery and diagnostic center and advanced wound care center. Ukiah is a unique small town that charms you with its rich character, arts, vineyards and natural surroundings. Ukiah beckons you to explore all that the valley has to offer amidst our 300 days of sunshine each year. We are also conveniently located just two hours north of San Francisco and 45 minutes from the Pacific Coast.

Job Summary:

Provides overall supervision of the organization in collaboration with and in the absence of the administrative/executive team. Makes administrative decisions, collaborates with the Nursing Directors and other departments, ensures patient and staff safety, and oversees the functioning of the organization. Assists with/facilitates clinical functions. Supervises and directs the activities of various levels of assigned personnel using both professional and supervisory discretion and independent judgment.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree in nursing or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Required
  • Master's Degree: Preferred
  • Five years' technical experience: Preferred
  • One year's experience working in a critical care setting: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Registered Nurse (RN) licensure in the state of practice: Required
  • Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) certification or Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required for all facilities, except Behavioral Health
  • Clinical specialty and/or nursing administration certification: Preferred

Facility Specific License/Certifications:

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification or Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required
  • Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required
  • Trauma Nursing Core Course (TNCC): Required

Essential Functions:

  • Supervises nursing personnel and operations by making rounds on a regular basis. Assesses routine and non-routine conditions of patients through identification of symptoms and behavioral changes, reviewing histories of physiological/psychological, cultural and spiritual information, reviewing medical data such as medical history, physical exams, plan of care, etc. Works with staff in unusual cases to develop a prioritized interdisciplinary plan of care. May assist staff to revise the plan of care to meet changing needs of patients, making appropriate referrals, i.e. dietary, spiritual care, etc. Responds to all acute unit codes. Attends to medical emergencies for inpatients. Works with other area supervisors when needed to provide advice or assistance.

Participates in discharge planning with patients, physicians, social workers, patient education, utilization review and other personnel as appropriate.

Assists with orientation and training of registry/traveler staff, new and existing employees, assisting them in learning department routines, policies and procedures, etc. Supervises the quality and effectiveness of patient care delivered throughout the Hospital, using such methods as: direct observation, rounds, reviewing reports, checking documentation in the medical record, and exerting influence and giving direction to employees as needed. Ensures compliance of team with applicable laws, rules and regulations.
  • Maintains and adjusts unit-based staffing in order to meet patient needs, while observing regulatory mandates, budget guidelines and needs throughout the hospital.
  • Evaluates employee, patient, family, and physician complaints. Responds courteously and promptly and resolves problems within the scope of delegated authority, consulting with administration as required. In the review of patient conditions, works with patients, family, physician, and healthcare team members in order to maintain standards of acceptable quality care.

title: Vice Provost, School of Creative Arts, Entertainment and Design
description:
Applications must be submitted no later than 11:59 p.m. CT on the day before the listed closing date.


Weekly Work Hours

40

Compensation Range

A91

Salary Minimum

$195,600.00 Annually

FLSA

United States of America (Exempt)

Work Location

  • All positions are considered on-site roles.
  • After six months of employment, some positions may be eligible to apply for a hybrid work arrangement based on job responsibilities, operational needs, supervisor approval, and Dallas College policy.
  • Academic (Faculty) positions require an on-campus presence, even when teaching online courses, in accordance with state law.

Position Type

Administrator

Position Summary

Dallas College seeks a visionary, collaborative and forward-thinking academic leader to serve as Vice Provost of the School of Creative Arts, Entertainment and Design. Reporting to the Provost & Chief Academic Officer, the Vice Provost will provide strategic leadership for academic quality, student success, faculty and academic manager development, program effectiveness, resource stewardship and partnerships with employers and community organizations.

This is a distinctive opportunity to shape learning across creative disciplines while helping students move from education to meaningful careers. The School’s work brings together classroom learning, creative practice, experiential opportunities and external partnerships. Dallas College has highlighted CAED-related experiences such as Design Week, the Future of Fashion Showcase and collaboration with Universidad Creativa in Costa Rica through fashion, exchange-program development and Collaborative Online International Learning.

The Vice Provost will provide leadership for the planning, implementation and evaluation of programs within the School; advocate for students, faculty, instructors, local business and industry; advise the Provost on professional and technical education; and actively engage community and employer partners to create new partnerships, responsive programs and revenue opportunities.

The School of Creative Arts, Entertainment and Design (CAED) prepares students for careers across the creative economy through programs in the arts, design, entertainment, media, and related disciplines. Serving approximately 45,000 students and supported by over 250 full-time faculty, CAED combines academic excellence with industry-relevant learning experiences that help students develop the creative, technical, and professional skills needed for success.

The school also includes English, Communications, and World Languages, disciplines that are central to the college's academic mission and student success agenda. These programs deliver many of the gateway and general education courses that students encounter early in their academic journey, helping build the communication, critical-thinking, cultural competency, and language skills that underpin achievement across virtually every field of study.

The Vice Provost for Creative Arts, Entertainment and Design provides strategic leadership for one of Dallas College's largest and most dynamic academic schools. This role helps ensure that academic programs remain responsive to student needs, industry trends, workforce demands, and emerging opportunities within the creative and entertainment sectors.

The successful candidate will understand the distinct needs of creative and career-connected programs and will be able to build a shared vision across disciplines and locations. The leader will strengthen academic pathways, support relevant curriculum and instruction, expand experiential learning and employment pipelines, and advocate for students, faculty and staff across Dallas College and in the broader community.

Why This Role Matters

The Vice Provost will help connect creative education with student opportunity, industry relevance and community impact. This leader will:

  • Set a clear and inspiring vision for the School and align that vision with Dallas College’s mission and strategic goals.

  • Advance student success through strong pathways, degree maps, academic support and continuous improvement.

  • Support high-quality curriculum, instruction, assessment and faculty professional development across creative disciplines.

  • Build partnerships that expand experiential learning, community engagement and employment opportunities for students.

  • Champion interdisciplinary collaboration among creative fields and across Dallas College functions.

  • Steward people, budgets and resources while identifying opportunities for grants, fundraising and sustainable growth.

  • Represent and advocate for the School, its programs and its people within Dallas College and throughout the community.

CAED plays an important role in advancing Dallas College's mission by creating pathways that connect students to high-demand and culturally impactful careers while supporting the region's creative economy in one of the most vibrant creative arts centers in the world.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee faculty and academic managers, with direct responsibility for academic excellence initiatives, including curriculum strategy, student learning outcomes and assessment, tutoring and supplemental academic support, instruction, and faculty professional development.

  • Develop and maintain student pathways and degree maps within the School, ensuring students can access the courses and programs needed to reach economic security and success.

  • Oversee School programs and faculty, administrators and staff across geographic locations, ensuring consistency of offerings and a seamless student experience.

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external organizations to build capacity for experiential learning and employment pipelines for completers.

  • Coordinate with Academic Services to provide students access to tailored academic resources, including library and tutoring support.

  • Ensure curriculum and program excellence through benchmarking and assessment of School and community needs.

  • Complete required Dallas College professional development hours each academic year.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of the purpose of community colleges.

  • Progressive experience as an academic administrator involving undergraduate and/or graduate programs, including responsibility for budgets, personnel recruitment and evaluation.

  • Experience in strategic planning, assessment of program effectiveness and development of guidelines to enhance academic units within the institution and with accrediting bodies.

  • Knowledge of curriculum design and its application to sound academic management.

Core Skills

Vision and Strategic Thinking

  • Set a clear and inspiring vision for the academic school, aligned with Dallas College’s mission and strategic goals.

  • Develop and implement plans that promote growth and excellence in education.

Educational Expertise

  • Demonstrate strong academic credentials and subject-matter expertise relevant to the School’s programs.

  • Understand current trends and innovations in pedagogy and curriculum development.

Collaboration and Team Building

  • Build and lead high-performing teams and foster a collaborative culture.

  • Promote cross-disciplinary and cross-functional collaboration to enhance the student experience.

Communication

  • Articulate the School’s mission, goals and achievements to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Listen effectively to the needs and concerns of faculty, staff and students.

Student-Centered Leadership

  • Demonstrate a commitment to student success, including initiatives that improve retention, completion and academic achievement.

  • Understand the needs of students from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.

Data-Informed Decision-Making

  • Use data to inform decisions and program improvements.

  • Emphasize outcomes assessment and continuous improvement in educational offerings.

Innovation and Adaptability

  • Embrace innovation and adapt to changes in the educational landscape, including technology and teaching methods.

  • Anticipate and respond to emerging trends in higher education and relevant creative industries.

Resource Management

  • Manage budgets and resources effectively while prioritizing academic quality.

  • Apply grant-writing and fundraising skills to secure additional resources for the School.

Advocacy and Representation

  • Advocate for the School and its faculty, staff and students within Dallas College and in the broader community.

  • Build strong relationships with external partners, including local businesses and industry stakeholders.

Ethical Leadership and Resilience

  • Demonstrate ethical, transparent leadership, integrity and social responsibility.

  • Create a welcoming environment and lead effectively in a complex, changing educational landscape.

Physical Requirements

Normal physical job functions are performed within a standard office environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties and responsibilities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree required; earned doctorate preferred, as confirmed by official transcripts.

  • Five years of progressively responsible teaching, administrative and/or educational leadership experience.

  • Three years of upper-level administrative or supervisory experience in a community college or higher education environment.

  • Demonstrated successful experience in leadership, strategic planning, fiscal management, resource allocation and personnel supervision.

  • Demonstrated distinguished record of teaching, scholarly publications and/or creative accomplishments that reflects a commitment to academic excellence.

  • Will be subject to a criminal background check. Some positions may be subject to a fingerprint check.

About Dallas College

Since 1965, Dallas College has served more than three million students and today stands among the largest community college systems in Texas. With seven campuses across the Dallas-Fort Worth region, Dallas College is committed to placing students at the center of everything we do while creating pathways to educational attainment, career readiness and economic prosperity.

Dallas College is committed to fostering an environment of opportunity, belonging and excellence for our students, employees and communities. We celebrate the richness of diverse backgrounds, experiences, perspectives and ideas and believe they strengthen our institution and our impact.

Join Us

This role represents an opportunity to shape the future of creative education at Dallas College, strengthen pathways from learning to meaningful careers, and expand the partnerships and experiences that help students thrive. The Vice Provost will lead across academic quality, student success, faculty development, program innovation and community engagement while advocating for the School’s students, faculty, staff and programs.

Join a college committed to transforming lives and communities through higher education. In this leadership role, you will partner with faculty, administrators, industry leaders, and community stakeholders to shape the future of creative arts, entertainment, and design education in one of the nation's largest community college systems.

If you are a visionary academic leader who is committed to student success, creative excellence, collaboration, innovation and community impact, we encourage you to apply.

title: Founding Product Engineer
description:
About the Role

This is a founding-level product engineering role at a fast-growing, European-headquartered startup building an AI-powered phone assistant for small and medium-sized businesses. The platform automates inbound and outbound calls, appointment scheduling, customer service, and other communication workflows — with a strong focus on the German-speaking market and a privacy-first, data-sovereign architecture built in Europe.

You'll join a lean, high-ownership engineering team at an early stage (recently closed a Seed / Series A round backed by prominent European and global investors) and have a direct impact on product direction, architecture, and customer outcomes. The company has grown from a handful of people to ~50 in under two years and is continuing to scale rapidly.

Native-level German proficiency is a firm requirement for this role. You must be able to work with CET time-zone overlap. An optional office in Vienna, Austria is available.

What You'll Do

  • Own features end-to-end — from hypothesis and prototype through to production release — for a product used by thousands of companies across Europe.

  • Lead product discovery by designing and running rapid experiments to validate ideas before committing to large-scale builds.

  • Maintain close, recurring contact with customers, partners, and the Sales team to surface real pain points and translate them into product decisions.

  • Design and implement tracking and analytics to support data-driven iteration.

  • Build across the full stack, driving architecture decisions through to release.

  • Prioritise pragmatic solutions that balance speed of validation with long-term scalability.

  • Take radical ownership of initiatives and move them forward autonomously, without waiting for sign-offs.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves (dealbreakers):

  • 3+ years of product engineering experience delivering end-to-end software features.

  • Strong full-stack proficiency: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, and React.

  • Native-level German fluency (Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau) — non-negotiable.

Required:

  • Experience integrating software with external systems such as CRMs, calendar apps, and databases.

  • Ability to gather customer feedback and translate pain points into product decisions in collaboration with customers, partners, and sales.

  • Comfort identifying, tracking, and analysing relevant metrics to drive data-driven decisions.

  • End-to-end development experience — from architecture choices to production deployment.

Nice to have:

  • Experience integrating LLMs or building AI-powered product features (e.g. OpenAI or similar).

  • Familiarity with GDPR compliance and EU AI Act considerations in product development.

  • Experience working in a remote-first, asynchronous collaboration environment.

  • Background in early-stage or high-growth startup environments.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
DESE Research, Inc. is seeking a talented, motivated, and collaborative Full-Stack Developer to join a multidisciplinary team of software developers, data engineers, analysts, and researchers. This role supports the development of data-intensive web applications that combine Python backends, React/TypeScript front ends, and large language model (LLM) capabilities using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). If you enjoy working across the software stack and applying emerging technologies to complex defense challenges, we want to hear from you!

Job Details:

The candidate will work as part of a collaborative Agile team to design, build, test, and deploy web applications that process and analyze large volumes of data. The technical environment includes Flask and Django, React and TypeScript, PostgreSQL, ArangoDB, Qdrant, Docker, Kubernetes, asynchronous Python, Celery, continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing. Our developers are cross-functional, and contribute to containerization, deployment, and testing while supporting infrastructure in addition to feature development. This position follows a hybrid schedule in Huntsville, Alabama.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain features across Python backends using Flask or Django and React/TypeScript front ends.
  • Develop and maintain APIs, user interfaces, background services, and data-processing workflows.
  • Work with relational, NoSQL, and vector databases, including PostgreSQL, ArangoDB, and Qdrant or similar technologies.
  • Integrate LLM capabilities using the OpenAI SDK, vLLM inference servers, RAG patterns, embeddings, and vector search.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines that process and analyze datasets ranging up to terabyte scale.
  • Use asynchronous Python and task orchestration tools such as Celery to support background processing and long-running jobs.
  • Containerize applications with Docker and contribute to deployment and operations in Kubernetes environments.
  • Contribute to continuous integration pipelines, unit tests, integration tests, code reviews, and deployment infrastructure.
  • Participate in daily standups, two-week sprints, backlog refinement, and other Agile development activities.
  • Communicate progress and technical decisions clearly through documentation, status updates, and live customer demonstrations.
  • Collaborate across the team, share ownership of the codebase, and help prevent technical knowledge from becoming siloed.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • 2-10 years of relevant software development experience. Relevant skills may be demonstrated through professional experience, internships, coursework, research, or substantial technical projects, as appropriate to the candidate's career level.
  • Proficiency in Python and an understanding of core web development concepts, including HTTP, REST APIs, and JSON.
  • Familiarity with Python web frameworks, such as Flask or Django.
  • Working knowledge of front-end development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript, with familiarity with React.
  • Understanding of relational databases, SQL, and fundamental data-modeling concepts.
  • Familiarity with Git, software testing concepts, and collaborative software-development practices.
  • Ability to work in a Linux development environment or quickly develop that capability.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work collaboratively and present technical progress to customers.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.
  • Ability and willingness to work a hybrid schedule and relocate to the Huntsville, Alabama area if not already local.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional experience developing production applications with Flask or Django and React with TypeScript.
  • Experience with modern front-end tooling and state-management libraries such as Vite, Zustand, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and NoSQL or vector databases such as ArangoDB, Qdrant, MongoDB, pgvector, or Weaviate.
  • Experience with asynchronous Python, asyncio, Celery, task queues, or background-job orchestration.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or operating inference services such as vLLM, including hands-on work with RAG, embeddings, chunking strategies, retrieval, or evaluation.
  • Experience designing data pipelines, writing efficient queries, and processing large datasets at hundreds-of-gigabytes or terabyte scale.
  • Experience writing Dockerfiles and deploying, scaling, or troubleshooting applications in Kubernetes.
  • Experience developing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated use of unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including mocking, test fixtures, and quality gates.
  • Experience evaluating architecture options and making sound tradeoffs involving performance, scalability, security, maintainability, and deployment.
  • Experience leading feature areas, mentoring other developers, or translating complex customer needs into actionable technical work.
  • Coursework, certification, research, or professional experience in AI/ML, data science, MLOps, LLMs, or related areas.
  • Prior software-engineering experience supporting defense, government, mission-critical, or other regulated environments.
  • Track record of producing clear technical documentation and delivering effective customer-facing presentations or demonstrations.

The ideal candidate is a career-minded individual who wants to become a part of something bigger. DESE has industry-leading benefits including a generous profit-sharing plan, competitive pay, but perhaps most importantly, the opportunity to work with the best and the brightest in the industry in support of the US warfighter. Launching a career with DESE allows you to put your skills and experience to good use doing crucial, mission-critical work that our country's armed forces and others depend on.

DESE is committed to creating a company that is known for its respect and care for employees. We understand that happy employees are what keeps our business going and we strive to provide the best opportunities for each individual working on our team! Here are a few reasons you will love working for DESE:

· Competitive salaries

· Annual performance bonuses

· Robust 401K profit sharing plan

· Competitive health, dental & vision insurance with affordable premiums

· Two different flexible spending account options

· Company paid life insurance & Accidental Death & Dismemberment

· Education reimbursement program

· Personal leave for approved philanthropic activities

· Vacation, Sick, & Holiday leave

· Opportunities for internal promotions

· Employee referral incentive program

· Rewards and gifts for service anniversaries

Disability Accommodation for Applicants - DESE Research, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in its job application procedures. If you have any difficulty using our online system and you need an accommodation due to a disability, you may use the following alternative email address or phone number to contact us about your interest in employment with us: hrandsecurity@dese.com or 256-837-8004x123.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
About Coinflow

Coinflow is the next-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud & chargeback indemnity, global pay-ins, multi-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide.

Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi-billion-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments.

Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at .

Role Overview

Coinflow is seeking a Head of Engineering to lead our engineering team and take ownership of day-to-day engineering, including prioritization, delivery, technical direction, and team health, that currently runs through the CTO. Coinflow is white-label payments infrastructure: card acquiring, payin/payout across numerous methods, hosted and embedded checkout, and merchant onboarding, operating in a heavily regulated environment where the bar for correctness, security, and reliability is high and non-negotiable.

This is a player-coach role, not a hands-off management job. You'll be in the codebase shipping real work on critical payment paths while building and leading the team. You own the team's deliverables — when something is late, broken, or unclear, it's yours to drive to done.

The first 6-12 months: this role is built around a handoff. Early on, you'll work closely with the CTO and ship alongside the team to earn context and trust. As you prove out judgment and delivery, more of the day-to-day — planning, technical decisions, team ownership — shifts to you. Success looks like the team running confidently under you while the CTO steps back from operational engineering.

Key Responsibilities

In the trenches (player)

  • Write, review, and ship production code on critical payment paths — you stay hands-on

  • Debug the hard stuff: production incidents, reliability gaps, performance and correctness issues

  • Set the technical direction and make the architecture calls that matter

  • Raise the engineering bar through code review, standards, and example

Leading the team (coach)

  • Own delivery — break work down, sequence it, and make sure it lands

  • Mentor every engineer on the team, from senior to junior, leveling people up rather than just directing them

  • Manage and grow the engineers: 1:1s, feedback, performance, hiring, and the occasional hard conversation

  • Own the process — clear requirements before work hits engineering, real ownership per project (DRI), and a feedback loop that catches problems early

  • Be the point of accountability for the team's output to the founders

  • Report to the CTO on personnel matters — performance, team health, and people decisions run through you and surface to the CTO directly

Required Qualifications

  • Senior engineering leader who is still a strong, current IC — able to hold your own in the codebase, not just review it

  • Track record owning delivery for a team: shipping real product, on a real cadence, with real accountability

  • Experience building process without bureaucracy — you know the difference between rigor and overhead

  • Comfortable in our stack: TypeScript/Node (Express, React), MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis/queues

  • High bar for reliability, security, and correctness — you've operated where mistakes cost money

  • Direct communicator — you write things down and don't hide bad news

Preferred Qualifications

  • Payments experience (acquiring, card networks, ACH, chargebacks, PCI)

  • Stablecoin or blockchain infrastructure experience (Solana programs, EVM smart contracts, on-chain settlement)

  • Experience working in a regulated, compliance-forward environment

  • Early-stage startup experience

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation including base salary, performance bonus, and meaningful ownership

  • Opportunity to own engineering delivery and team leadership at a rapidly scaling fintech company

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment with world-class investors

  • Direct impact on core product and company trajectory during a hyper growth phase

The base salary range for this role is $220,000 - $275,000 USD. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications and business needs.

In addition, the employee who fills this role will be eligible for an equity grant, allowing you to share in the long-term success of the company. You will also have access to a wide array of benefits, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) savings plan, and flexible time off.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.
